eugene patilio.name: Eugene Patilio
eugene patilio.origin: Eugene Patilio's father, Vincent Patilio, was an inventor who had never created anything successful. Eugene's mother, Rosie, was the breadwinner in the family, and her salary kept them afloat financially until she died of cancer. With Vincent earning barely enough to pay the rent for his and Eugene's home, the young boy had to get his own job while he was still in school. Eugene worked his tail off after school and had less time for studying. Vincent eventually devised electrically-powered coils that he then fashioned into a costume and embarked on an ill-fated career as the villainous Leap-Frog, which saw him end up in prison. When searching through a closet in their home, Eugene discovered the Leap-Frog suit. Eugene took the suit to his own bedroom, then started wearing it. Believing that there was only one way for Vincent to stop being haunted by the ghost of Leap-Frog, Eugene decided to adopt the costume and identity to use it as a powerful symbol for good. Eugene began an earnest, if somewhat clumsy, battle against crime. In attempting to help Spider-Man and the Human Torch, Eugene accidentally succeeded in defeating the criminal Speed Demon. Greatly encouraged by this victory, Patilio rechristened himself "the Fabulous Frog-Man," feeling that his new codename had more pizzazz than the previous one. thumb|left Vincent was proud of his son for capturing the Speed Demon, but his pride turned to disapproval as Eugene continued to serve as a super hero. Patilio assisted, of sorts, Captain America, and later tried unsuccessfully to join the super team Defenders. Afterward, Patilio was encouraged by Spider-Man to join with the Toad and Spider-Kid in forming the Misfits, although they disbanded almost immediately afterward. Later, Patilio defeated the villain White Rabbit with the help of his father, who had donned a version of the Leap Frog costume again. Frog-Man was soon captured by Alyosha Kravinoff and used like an ordinary animal, for Kraven's hunting pleasure. He was held on a boat with other animal-themed super-criminals, such as Rhino, Vulture, the second Kangaroo, Swarm and others. Kraven would drug them and fight them to prove his superiority. He was stopped by the Punisher, but Kraven got away. After the superhuman civil war, Frog-Man was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative, and was recruited into the Action Pack team. During the Secret Invasion, this Patilio was revealed to be a Skull infiltrator and after the invasion was over, the real Frog-Man joined a support group meeting for people who had been replaced by Skrulls. During Spider-Island, Frog-Man helped The Avengers to defeat Flag-Smasher and U.L.T.I.M.A.T.U.M., who were attacking the U.N. at the moment. He wished to establish a partnership with Ms. Marvel. As usual, through sheer luck, Frog-Man helped the team win the battle and save the day. Eugene once started working as a busboy at Isaac's Oysters, a restaurant in Greenwich Village run by retired vigilante Gargoyle. After the android Korvac resurfaced and embarked in a plan to regain his godhood, he came to blows with Iron Man and Hellcat. When Stark saw himself forced to recruit allies under Korvac's radar, Frog-Man was one of the heroes suggested by Hellcat. Alongside Gargoyle, Frog-Man became part of the ragtag group of heroes, which joined Iron Man as he pursued Korvac into outer space. Iron Man and his "Space Friends" raced Korvac to Taa II. They barely failed, and the villain managed to tap into the Power Cosmic to attain godhood. Iron Man followed suit in a last-ditch effort that saw Korvac's defeat. The heroes returned to Earth, but Tony had become corrupted by the Power Cosmic. The Space Friends colluded with Doctor Doom to strip him of the Power Cosmic, but the plan backfired after they lured Stark into a trap, and he killed all of them, save for Hellcat, in a fit of blind rage. After snapping out of it, Iron Man relinquished the Power Cosmic and returned to normal, but not before bringing everybody back to life.

eugene somma.name: Eugene Somma
eugene somma.origin: The Presidential Press Secretary, Eugene Somma gave a press conference in the White House where he explained how the President of the United States was worried by the aggressivity and tension caused by General Navatilas, president of South American country Medisuela who had been supported by the United States, but had lost this support due to Navatilas' alleged crimes. The press perceived this as a veiled warning for Navatilas in a situation that could escalate into an open war.

eugene stivak.name: Eugene Stivak
eugene stivak.origin: Stivak was a prominent U.S. Senator, but his background is largely unknown. He rose to power as the head of the Corporation's east-coast branch. In addition he maintained an alliance with the Dire Wraiths. The Wraiths required his help in creating a battlesuit that would be capable of besting their archenemy Rom in combat. Stivak entrusted this task to his own nephew Michael Stivak, but lied to the young man about the true purpose of the suit. He also deceived his own superiors in the Corporation, who were convinced that the suit would be an asset for their organization. Michael created the Torpedo Armor as planned, but he somehow learned part of his uncle's evil schemes. He delivered an inferior version of the Armor to Eugene, while keeping an improved version for himself. Eugene realized the deception and tried to acquire the Armor's design notes for study. Michael assumed the vigilante identity of Torpedo, and set out to destroy these notes. Michael was killed before completing his mission, but the task was completed by his successor Brock Jones. Eugene Stivak and the Corporation could neither control the Torpedo Armor, nor duplicate it without these design notes. Stivak had ordered the assassination of the Defector, but he was informed that his initial assassin had failed. He wanted his associate Veda to pass the task to her pet assassin, the Night Flyer. She praised the assassin's perfect record and his solid reputation, but Stivak confided to her that he had doubts concerning the Flyer's reliability. He thought that the Flyer was "too weird" to trust, and he alluded to having heard some wild rumors about this assassin. Stivak used his inferior version of the Torpedo Armor to create derivative battlesuits for a new group of operatives, the Rocketeers. The Rocketeers were tasked with retrieving the improved Torpedo Armor, but they were easily defeated by Daredevil. Stivak yelled at Ainsley Wescott, the current leader of the Rocketeers. He blamed Wescott for the mission's failure, but gave him one more chance to retrieve the Torpedo Armor. Stivak subsequently had a meeting with a few other members of the Corporation, explaining to them that the goal of his plans was to conquer the United States of America. Having discovered Stivak's role in the Corporation, Torpedo (Brock Jones) broke into Stivak's office. Stivak was absent, but he monitored the situation from a distance through hidden cameras. Stivak send his Rocketeers against Torpedo, and they easily defeated the outnumbered hero. Stivak had his new captive transported to his own mansion in Westchester. Stivak and his men were unable to get the battlesuit off the captive hero, despite their constant efforts to do so. An attempt to torture Torpedo backfired and the captive broke free. His initial physical attacks on Stivak angered the senator sufficiently to try to fight back, instead of letting the Rocketeers fight for him. In addition he maintained an alliance with the Dire Wraiths. The Wraiths required his help in creating a battlesuit that would be capable of besting their archenemy Rom in combat. Stivak entrusted this task to his own nephew Michael Stivak, but lied to the young man about the true purpose of the suit. He also deceived his own superiors in the Corporation, who were convinced that the suit would be an asset for their organization. Michael created the Torpedo Armor as planned, but he somehow learned part of his uncle's evil schemes. He delivered an inferior version of the Armor to Eugene, while keeping an improved version for himself. Eugene realized the deception and tried to acquire the Armor's design notes for study. Michael assumed the vigilante identity of Torpedo, and set out to destroy these notes. Michael was killed before completing his mission, but the task was completed by his successor Brock Jones. Eugene Stivak and the Corporation could neither control the Torpedo Armor, nor duplicate it without these design notes. Stivak had ordered the assassination of the Defector, but he was informed that his initial assassin had failed. He wanted his associate Veda to pass the task to her pet assassin, the Night Flyer. She praised the assassin's perfect record and his solid reputation, but Stivak confided to her that he had doubts concerning the Flyer's reliability. fields.notes: In early appearances, Stivak goes by his middle name, "Kligger". Stivak mentioned that he was acting on behalf of the Corporation's board of directors, and there are a few vague mentions of his own superiors within the ranks of the organization. However, the identities of these higher-ups are unclear. Justin Hammer was identified as an associate of the Corporation, with no clarification whether he was an ally or a member in his own right. The Corporation provided funding for Silvermane's operations and for Silvermane's branch of Hydra, but it was unclear whether Silvermane was a member of the organization or a convenient pawn. Fu Manchu had clearly declined offers of alliance or membership by the Corporation, telling the Corporation members that they were beneath him.

eugene sykes.name: Eugene Sykes
eugene sykes.origin: ===Early years=== Eugene Sykes' father was killed in World War II on the beaches of Normandy. left|thumb|200px|Eugene Sykes in a war A veteran of three military tours in Vietnam, Eugene Sykes had his knee blown out in the war on the Ho Chi Minh trail. He spent two years in a prisoner of war camp where he was tortured and not allowed to speak. When he made it home, he vowed to always speak his mind and stand up for freedom. Congressman Eugene Sykes built a political following by trying to push through a Mutant Registration Act. He was once angrily questioned by Sally Floyd, a reporter from the Alternative, who had known mutant connections, and left-winged opinions. ===M-Day=== After M-Day, when most of the world's mutants lost their powers, Sykes gave a press conference to let the world know that he did not plan on changing his stance on mutant registration, stating that even depowered mutants should still be required to register. He told several reporters that he considered mutants like bombs or weapons and that he sought to provide for the safety of the common man. Sykes was disgusted when Sally Floyd managed to make it into the press conference. She confronted him with questions about his fears and she met his defenses about the Constitution with bitterness and sarcasm, even calling him a "bigoted jackass." Floyd later published an article about Sykes that proved incredibly popular, and she embarrassed him in a televised debate weeks later. Former mutant Jubilee focused on fighting against Sykes politically while he continued working to gain support. Sykes appeared on Fox News in a debate against Sally Floyd after it was revealed that a serial killer, the Ghoul, was striking against ex-mutants. He cited acts of mutant terrorists such as Pyro, Toad, and Juggernaut as examples of his case, though Floyd pointed out that Juggernaut was not a mutant and even joked that Sykes may be one. Floyd cited past acts of racism and terrorism against minority groups, but Sykes was not swayed, considering mutants far too dangerous. ===Civil War=== Sykes learned that Sally Floyd was incarcerated for not revealing a source and planned to bail her out, though he wanted to teach her a lesson at the same time. He visited her and, avoiding her sarcasm, handed her an envelope that he told her to open later. He claimed to be a patriot and explained his motivations, telling her he was ailing her out and that the two of them were more similar than she realized. Floyd accused him of trying to trick her and he then instructed her to open the envelope, in which was a note predicting her very reaction. His point proven, he bailed her out.

eugene thompson.name: Eugene Thompson
eugene thompson.origin: ===Early Life=== Eugene "Flash" Thompson was a classmate of Peter Parker. Flash grew up in Forest Hills, Queens, New York. He lived only a few blocks from Peter's house. He lived with his father Harrison Thompson, a police officer in the New York Police Department, his mother Rose Thompson and his little sister Jessie. Flash was physically abused by his alcoholic father, leading to Flash's own violent, bullying nature. ===Midtown High School=== Like Peter Parker, Flash attended Midtown High School, where he bullied Peter daily. The bullying continued for a long time even after Peter gained his spider-powers who never used them against Flash, even when tempted to do so. The only exception was a boxing match between the two in the school gym, where Peter evaded Flash's punches with his reflexes and knocked him out with a single punch. However, this was passed off as an accident and any suspicion of Parker actually being Spider-Man was moved onto Flash himself due to events involving the Living Brain. After this, Flash stopped his physical abuse, although he continued to taunt Peter. thumb|left|Flash in high school Flash's wide circle of friends included Brian "Tiny" McKeever, Jason Ionello, Seymour O'Reilly, Charlie and numerous female admirers such as Sally Avril and Liz Allan; the latter was Flash's steady girlfriend for some time. Eugene earned his iconic "Flash" nickname due to his poor performance in bed. However, he claimed that he earned it from his high school football career. Flash was Midtown High's star quarterback. This gained him popularity and respect, but he still remained jealous of Peter's book smarts. Ironically, Flash became an ardent supporter of Spider-Man, despite popular opinion against him. He even formed a Spider-Man Fan Club while still in high school and invited everyone except Peter Parker to join and scared away Daily Bugle staffers when they tried to interview people about their reasons for hating Spider-Man. Flash once tried to play a trick on Peter by dressing in a Spider-Man costume and attempting to frighten him. Before Flash could surprise Peter, he was abducted by Doctor Doom, who mistakenly believed he was the real Spider-Man. Peter was forced to save his own worst rival. Flash dressed up as Spider-Man again to redeem his hero who was seen as a coward after having run from a confrontation with the Green Goblin. Flash confronted three car thieves, hoping to draw out the real Spider-Man, but was beaten up by the three thugs. When Flash's girlfriend Liz became attracted to Peter and started snubbing him, calling him a "muscle-bound goop", this only made Flash hate Peter all the more. He threatened Parker not to hang around Liz too much, but when Peter got into trouble with the school principal, Mr. Davis, over their fight, Flash took responsibility for the incident. He still continued to pursue Liz, even though she made it clear that she wanted nothing to do with him. ===Empire State University=== Flash graduated from high school and enrolled at Empire State University on an athletic scholarship, becoming once more a classmate to Peter. Even though at first he continued his rivalry with Peter, turning his new classmates Harry Osborn and Gwen Stacy against him, eventually, they became close friends, also because Gwen befriended Peter and made the two bury the hatchet. ===United States Army=== By the time Flash left college to join the army, he and Peter parted as friends. During his tour of duty, Flash was stationed in Southeast Asia, where he stumbled across a hidden temple whose residents, notably the beautiful Sha Shan, nursed a wounded Flash back to health; however, after American forces mistakenly shelled the temple despite Flash's efforts to protect it, Flash left the army to return to America, where temple survivors who mistakenly blamed him for the tragedy made attempts on his life. With the aid of Spider-Man, Flash lived to convince the temple survivors of his innocence, and was briefly reunited with Sha Shan. ===Return to Civilian Life=== Flash returned to civilian life and college and was among the many friends who paid their respects with Peter at Gwen Stacy's funeral. He was injured in a car crash when a new Vulture kidnapped his and Peter's friend Mary Jane Watson. He befriended Liz Allen once more and they went on a cruise together with Peter and Mary Jane. However, the cruise ship was kidnapped by the Tarantula. They were rescued by Spider-Man, which caused Flash to become suspicious of Parker's double life. When Harry Osborn became the Green Goblin and found out about his secret identity, he blew up Peter's apartment and kidnapped Flash, Mary Jane and Peter's Aunt May before being defeated by Spider-Man. His apartment in ruins, Flash took Peter in and helped him move when Peter had found a new apartment. When Harry Osborn was released, apparently cured from the insanity that had caused him to become the Green Goblin, Flash took him in as his new roommate. Late

He was injured in a car crash when a new Vulture kidnapped his and Peter's friend Mary Jane Watson. He befriended Liz Allen once more and they went on a cruise together with Peter and Mary Jane. However, the cruise ship was kidnapped by the Tarantula. They were rescued by Spider-Man, which caused Flash to become suspicious of Parker's double life. When Harry Osborn became the Green Goblin and found out about his secret identity, he blew up Peter's apartment and kidnapped Flash, Mary Jane and Peter's Aunt May before being defeated by Spider-Man. His apartment in ruins, Flash took Peter in and helped him move when Peter had found a new apartment. When Harry Osborn was released, apparently cured from the insanity that had caused him to become the Green Goblin, Flash took him in as his new roommate. Late
fields.personality: As a result of chronic abuse by his violent, alcoholic father, Flash Thompson became a bully during his high-school years, picking on students weaker than himself — namely Peter Parker — in order to vent his anger and frustration. Nevertheless desiring his father's approval above all else, Flash pushed himself to excel in sports, embodying the stereotype of a dumb jock. Inspired by Spider-Man's selfless heroism, Flash eventually straightened himself out and joined the military in order to prove himself a hero, but was ashamed and haunted by his past as a bully. Remaining hot-tempered and lapsing into alcoholism, Flash despaired at the parallels he saw between himself and his father. Upon becoming Agent Venom, Flash's aspirations to be a super hero clashed with both his military superiors' orders — eventually leading to him going AWOL to protect his family; and with the predatory urges of the symbiote, which was kept suppressed by a suppressant chemical but would resurface if Flash became too angry. After joining the Secret Avengers and the Thunderbolts, Flash came to realize just how heavy the burden of being a hero was when his new rogues gallery and the feral symbiote attacked his family; eventually leaving for Philadelphia to protect them and try to leave his past behind. Upon the Venom symbiote being cleansed, Flash's relationship with it began anew and he came to consider it his comrade and partner, to the point that even when it was re-corrupted, he endeavored to save it from itself. Flash blamed himself for the death of Andrea Benton's father, and despite having never wanted children out of fear he'd turn out like his own dad he became a surrogate father and mentor to her. Thompson sank into a deep depression when he was separated from Venom. Not only was he worried sick about his friend and partner, he also missed being a super hero. He was eventually brought out of his depression by his determination to reunite with his former symbiote. Flash initially rejected the notion of the symbiote having returned to Eddie Brock, but learned to respect Brock and accept him as the symbiote's host after he showed his heroic side while fighting Maniac.

fields.notes: When Flash loses control of the suit, his appearance frequently changes to that of the "classic" Venom, Eddie Brock, occasionally retaining the spikes on his shoulders, arms, and legs and white-rimmed black eyes. Other times the white spider emblems have remained the same, or reverted to their appearance of Mac Gargan's Venom form. He can generate two mouths from the side of his neck, although he has only done so once. As a member of the Red Hulk's Thunderbolts, Flash recolored the white areas of the symbiote red, making it resemble Randy Schueller's original concept art for the black suit.
fields.trivia: Flash is the nephew of actress Lea Thompson. Flash had an F.B.I. file when he was still in high school, after starting one of only three Spider-Man fan clubs. Dan Slott revealed on Twitter that the Go Down Swinging was going to end with the implication that Flash may have survived being electrocuted by the Red Goblin, but this was removed when the editors pointed out it would cheapen his sacrifice.

eugene turbot weiderspan.origin: Eugene was a human archeologist who searched for the Ruby of Cyttorak, hoping to gain its mythical powers. He discovered the ruby and the accompanying tablet and used them to gain the powers of the Juggernaut. Eugene had little understanding of how powerful he had become and used his new physique to try and pick up and date women. He was found by the X-Men who took the gem from him to return it to the original Juggernaut who had been put into a critical condition when the power was taken from him. Soon after the power was transferred back to Cain, reverting Eugene back to normal.

eugene walker.name: Eugene Walker
eugene walker.origin: Eugene Walker was a 14-years old mutants. He joined the Xavier Institute some time after it reopened. Together with his friends, View and Quill, Eugene tried to steal answers for exam from Shadowcat's desk, but they were caught by her. She asked Gambit to talk with them and after spending a day with Gambit they were all awestruck. Eugene decided to become an X-Man in the future, while Quill wanted to become a thief, and View wanted to become both thief and an X-Man. On M-Day only 27 of 182 students of the Xavier Institute retained their powers. Majority of the depowered students left the Institute safely, but when the last 42 of them were sent out on the bus it was destroyed by the Purifiers. Eugene was among the students who lost their powers, but it is unknown if he managed to leave or was killed by William Stryker and the Purifiers.

eugene wildeman.name: Eugene Wildeman
eugene wildeman.first_appearance: Prime vs. The Incredible Hulk Vol 1 0
eugene wildeman.origin: Eugene Wildeman was a scientist who was a former colleague of scientist Bruce Banner aka the Hulk. Over time, Wildeman experiment on several teenagers with gamma radiation, turning them into mutated monsters. When Wildeman tried to lure in a girl in a rough neighborhood to experiment on, he was confronted by Prime, a superhero from Earth-93060. Prime then got into a fight with the Hulk, believing that Prime was attacking Wildeman. Hulk realized his error just as Wildeman sent his test subjects to attack Hulk and Prime so he could collect samples from the two heroes. Wildeman eventually revealed that he experimented on himself as well and transformed into a green-skinned giant. Wildeman was quickly defeated by Hulk and Prime and reverted back to his normal self. He was then arrested by the police.

euphoria.name: Euphoria
euphoria.origin: Euphoria is a living planet with a special adaptive atmosphere. It was found by the Silver Surfer and his companion Dawn Greenwood when they were looking for a new planet for the inhabitants of the now-destroyed Newhaven to live in. Which were in an exodus fleet of 3 billion ships carrying 6 billion refugees from Newhaven, consisting of the survivors of countless worlds that had been consumed by Galactus. thumb|left In order to protect itself from the survivors' grief, Euphoria's atmosphere medicated its inhabitants and treated them for their depression, inducing them in a state of constant happiness. However, it also started influencing the actions of its new inhabitants with the intent to make their lives better. Months after staying at "New Newhaven," the Surfer sensed something was wrong, used his powers to reveal the planet's true nature, and Euphoria revealed itself as a living creature. A group of the survivors decided to leave the planet as they didn't want to be Euphoria's puppets, but the vast majority remained on it. Following the death of Dawn Greenwood's father Reg, Dawn requested the Silver Surfer to return to Euphoria. Due to Euphoria's nature, the planet created a construct of Dawn's father, with which Dawn passed time once in a while over the following 67 days. Silver Surfer and Dr. Fuzmyer monitored the situation to ensure Euphoria was used as a treatment to help Dawn cope with her loss, rather than a way to escape from reality. After Mama Hub helped Dawn finally overcome her grief, she and Silver Surfer bid Euphoria and its inhabitants farewell once again. At one point in the distant past, Euphoria was given a Night Shard by the Olympian godhead Zeus for safekeeping. The Night Shards were the materialization of the power of Nyx, the rogue goddess of the night who had been imprisoned by her fellow Olympians, and the shard given to Euphoria represented The Night That Is. After escaping from her confinement and murdering the Olympians, Nyx sought out all the shards. Would-be heroine Voyager assembled a team of Earth's heroes to get them first. Eventually, the only shard left was The Night That Is, resulting in a confrontation between Nyx and the heroes in Euphoria's surface. Since the warring between the Avengers and Nyx threatened to disrupt her paradise, Euphoria materialized her true form in an attempt to deescalate the conflict. Euphoria questioned everybody at the scene to know their desires, but the fighting quickly resumed, causing Euphoria to become dazed by the creatures' violent nature and conflicting desires. Euphoria then approached Nyx, and let her rip the shard from inside her. Returned to her full power, Nyx fled. A dying Euphoria was approached by Voyager, who warned her that she hadn't heard her wish. When Voyager told Euphoria that her heart's desire was to be an Avenger, Euphoria used her final breaths to assure her that only Voyager herself could make it happen, which fueled Voyager with the determination to go after Nyx.

eurynome.name: Eurynome
eurynome.origin: ===Origin=== Eurynome was a sea nymph/Nereid, though other sources mentioned her as a Titan. ===Mother of Gods=== At the time Nox was believed to possibly be Nyx, she was said to be the daughter of Ophion and Eurynome. } With Zeus, she gave birth to Joya/Euphrosyne, the goddess of joy. When Hera gave birth to Hephaestus, she was mortified by his grotesque physical appearance, and threw him from the top of Mount Olympus. He was rescued and adopted by Eurynome and her fellow Nereid Thetis who educated and raised him in their grotto on the Isle of Lemnos, where Hephaestus took great pleasure in crafting inventions.

eurypylus.name: Eurypylus
eurypylus.origin: Eurypylus was the son of Telephus, the grandson of Heracles, King of Teuthrania, and a great warrior. Along with an army, he came to aid King Priam of Troy against the Argives. He led the Trojans, killing Machaon, son of Asclepius, in battle. In another battle, he met with Neoptolemus, son of Achilles (who had wounded his father Telephus, then healed him, in a battle in the prelude of the Trojan War.) This fight was observed by many: Trojans, Achaeans, Gods. Neoptolemus finally beat his opponent, plunging his father's ashen spear in Eurypylus' throat. Neoptolemus gloating over the dead body of Eurypylus caused God of War Ares to depart Olympus and join the Trojans, but he was interceptedby Athena who favored the Achaeans. Before they could clash, Zeus intervened, forcing them both to withdraw.

eurystheus.name: Eurystheus
eurystheus.origin: ===Ancient Times=== Eurystheus was the son of Sthenelus, and as such, the grandson of Perseus. He succeeded his father to the throne of Mycenae, at Tiryns, and became the Great King of Mycenae. He was fated to be Hercules' hated rival from birth and cousin. He was responsible for commissioning the Twelve Labors of Hercules. At each time Hercules returned from a task, Eurystheus feared him so much that would hide in a giant bronze jar. After Hercules' death, he tried to destroy everything related to Hercules, but was eventually defeated by Hercules' son Hyllus and was dragged towards Alcmena (Hercules' mother). He tried to explain to her he was doing Hera's will, but Alcmena pierced his eyes and Hyllus beheaded him. Hera came to the lifeless body and resurrected him, and Eurystheus sewed his head back. Over the years, he trained to cope with blindness, and also used plastic surgery. ===Modern Days=== ====New Labors==== Allied with Achelous and under Hera's secret leadership, he proposed to Hercules to pass New Labors. Hercules managed to pass the final labor: Obtaining the forgiveness of his wife Megara, whom he had murdered millennia before. Hera consequently left the enraged Eurystheus to confront Hercules. After a brief brawl, Eurystheus was decapitated by a falling mounted shield.

fields.history: ===Ancient Times=== Eurystheus was the son of Sthenelus, and as such, the grandson of Perseus. He succeeded his father to the throne of Mycenae, at Tiryns, and became the Great King of Mycenae. He was fated to be Hercules' hated rival from birth and cousin. He was responsible for commissioning the Twelve Labors of Hercules. At each time Hercules returned from a task, Eurystheus feared him so much that would hide in a giant bronze jar. After Hercules' death, he tried to destroy everything related to Hercules, but was eventually defeated by Hercules' son Hyllus and was dragged towards Alcmena (Hercules' mother). He tried to explain to her he was doing Hera's will, but Alcmena pierced his eyes and Hyllus beheaded him. Hera came to the lifeless body and resurrected him, and Eurystheus sewed his head back. Over the years, he trained to cope with blindness, and also used plastic surgery. ===Modern Days=== ====New Labors==== Allied with Achelous and under Hera's secret leadership, he proposed to Hercules to pass New Labors. Hercules managed to pass the final labor: Obtaining the forgiveness of his wife Megara, whom he had murdered millennia before. Hera consequently left the enraged Eurystheus to confront Hercules. After a brief brawl, Eurystheus was decapitated by a falling mounted shield.
powers: Eurystheus had an expanded life span granting him nearly indefinite life.

ev carley.name: Ev Carley
ev carley.origin: Ev Carley was a diver aboard the S.S. Recovery, a salvage ship exploring an area of the ocean that had not been salvaged in over three years. In 1939, when his colleague Rod Nelson was investigating a shipwreck, Nelson found a knife that had not rusted, a sign that someone had been down in the wreck recently. His chief mate, finding the story almost impossible to believe, sent Nelson back down with Carley. Investigating the wreck, the two men spotted the young Prince Namor. The boy, seeing all surface dwellers as enemies of his people, and not certain that they were even human due to their diving suits, cut the the cables providing air, telephone communication and gas for their torches and slew both men. He took their corpses back to Atlantis and presented them to the Holy One (Thakorr). Namor was praised by him and his mother Princess Fen. Princess Fen commanded to take the dead bodies of Nelson and Carley, and show those corpses to their people, as the first victory in their war of revenge against the surface dwellers.

eva bell.name: Eva Bell
eva bell.origin: ===Early Life=== Eva Bell was born and raised on the Gold Coast in Queensland, Australia. From a young age, she idolized Captain America, hoping one day to follow his example as a symbol of heroism for her nation. As a teenager, Eva was out one night with a friend when she spotted David, a boy she secretly liked. Their encounter went well until her older brother, the fiercely protective Steven, confronted them and a fight erupted between him and David's group. Frustrated and overwhelmed, Eva's mutant powers manifested for the first time, producing a massive temporal bubble that froze everything within for nearly twenty hours, including herself. The event drew national attention, and an Australian task force surrounded the stasis field. At that moment, Cyclops, Emma Frost, and Magneto arrived. They informed Eva that she was a mutant and helped her dissolve the bubble. When authorities tried to seize her, the outlaw X-Men intervened and whisked her away. ===Joining the New Xavier School=== thumb|left|Eva's power's manifesting Eva was taken to the abandoned Weapon X facility in Canada, which Cyclops had repurposed as the New Charles Xavier School for Mutants. There she befriended Christopher Muse, known as Triage. Though initially uncertain of Cyclops' motives particularly his rhetoric about a "mutant revolution" Eva accepted his offer, donned a costume, and adopted the codename Tempus. She quickly proved invaluable on missions to rescue and recruit new mutants, especially as hostility toward mutantkind increased after the Phoenix Five crisis. Her abilities were tested against advanced Sentinels suspected of being deployed by S.H.I.E.L.D.. On a trip home to the Gold Coast, Eva briefly reunited with her mother. Their meeting was cut short when the Avengers alerted by S.H.I.E.L.D. arrived to arrest Cyclops and Emma for their Phoenix-related crimes, including Cyclops’ murder of Professor X. The confrontation nearly turned violent, but Eva froze the Avengers in a time bubble to prevent bloodshed. Realizing she could not return to her old life, she departed again with the X-Men, troubled that she had fought against the heroes she admired as a child. ===Training and Growth=== Tempus' training was rigorous. During a mission in Limbo, she fought against Dormammu and narrowly survived. Later, during a sparring exercise, she accidentally trapped Magik in a bubble. When released, Magik reappeared seconds later, displaced forward in time. This revealed to Eva that her powers extended far beyond local stasis to manipulation of the time stream itself. She soon demonstrated this power in the field, saving Hijack from a Blockbuster Sentinel before collapsing from exhaustion. Cyclops praised her courage, but Eva was shaken by the growing scale of her powers. ===Time Lost=== During a survival training exercise in Tabula Rasa, Eva generated another bubble but vanished completely from her team’s sight. She had become "unstuck in time," uncontrollably leaping to new eras when threatened. Eva found herself in the American frontier of the 1870's. Locals reacted with hostility to her strange clothes and behavior until she encountered the Rawhide Kid, who befriended her and explained she was in 1875. To trigger her powers, he even threatened her life at gunpoint, which caused her to time jump again. Eva's next jump carried her to a version of the year 2099, where the local X-Men detected her arrival using Cerebro. They brought her to the Sorcerer Supreme, revealed to be a still living Magik, who had survived into the 22nd century. Magik trained Eva, advising restraint and helping her harness her powers. Eva settled into this future for seven years. She married Danny Warburton and gave birth to a daughter, Doll. Although Magik warned Eva that she would eventually have to return to her own time, Eva clung to her family and resisted. Demons eventually attacked Magik's sanctum. Mortally wounded, Magik demanded Eva return to her time and ensure that Beast faced justice. With her husband and daughter looking on, Eva's stress triggered another uncontrolled jump, tearing her away from them forever. Eva next landed in prehistory, where she was saved from Dinosaurs by Morgan Le Fay, imprisoned there by the Dark Avengers. Morgan attempted to manipulate Eva into returning her to power, even probing her mind to exploit her grief. Eva fought back and forced herself into the timestream again. Pushing further forward, Eva reached a divergent 2099, where she discovered Tony Stark had become Sorcerer Supreme. Stark explained that Eva's original timeline, along with her husband and child, no longer existed. Heartbroken, Eva accepted this truth. Stark guided her back to Tabula Rasa, teaching her that every choice created new branches of reality and that her role still lay in her native time. Eva reappeared only moments after vanishing, visibly older and emotionally scarred. Though her classmates noticed her altered appearance, she concealed her ordeal, c

eva belyakov.name: Eva Belyakov
eva belyakov.species: Human with Inhuman lineageCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids exposed to Terrigenesis
eva belyakov.origin: Eva Belyakov was an Inhuman granted enhanced strength through Terrigenesis. She also wanted her daughter Katya to be undergo the change, but Jiaying, seeing a darkness in Katya, refused to allow her to be exposed to the mists. Believing her daughter's birthright was denied to her, Eva stole Terrigen Crystals from the Inhumans and went on the run with her daughter. The mists gave Katya the ability to leech off a person's emotions with the simplest touch, giving her control over her victims. Since she was so young, Katya's powers drove her insane, and her mother became one of her victims. By 2008, they made their way to Bahrain, where they had attracted the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Phil Coulson approached her in an attempt to get her to turn herself over to them, but Eva violently rejected the offer and attacked Coulson. A team of thugs under Katya's control grabbed Eva and her daughter and took them to a nearby building. A team of S.H.I.E.L.D. agents soon followed to rescue Katya, who they believed to be a hostage. One agent, Melinda May, found Eva and killed her with a broken piece of furniture.

eva lysenkovitch.origin: Sickle was a member of Red Dawn, who were a team of Russian elite parahuman commandos who were placed into suspended animation in a submarine off the coast of New York. The initial plan was for the soldiers to be activated in the event the Cold War turned into a real war, however, the submarine was left untouched until it was discovered in the year 2099. Alchemax uncovered the sub and Tyler Stone began the process of waking the Soviet agents. Miguel O'Hara was also brought along and uncovered the truth and so tried to stop the process, only releasing Chernobyl.

eva quintero.origin: Eva Quintero is the cousin of Humberto Lopez, better known as the superhero Reptil. Her cousin considered her to be an overachiever, and she started attending college at a young age. At some point in her life, Eva began studying magic by herself and managed to master basic abilities such as the power to open portals and create blasts of energy. She later joined Strange Academy to continue her studies and befriended fellow Mexican student Germán Aguilar.

evald skorpion.name: Evald Skorpion
evald skorpion.origin: Dr. Evald Skorpion was a frequent enemy of Adam Brashear. The day Galactus first came to Earth, Adam and his son Kevin tracked down Skorpion's activities to a subterranean base in Egypt, from where Skorpion planned to use a portal to the Neutral Zone to tear reality apart due to dimensional feedback. When Kevin punched Skorpion, the villain fell into the console which controlled the portal, shorting the system. The portal expanded, transported Kevin to the Neutral Zone, and caused Skorpion to disintegrate. thumb|left|Human form His soul was captured in a crystal by the Maker many years later. He gave him a body genetically engineered from a gorilla and a scorpion, and became the forefront in W.H.I.S.P.E.R.'s "Life-Minus" experiment. Using a high-dimensional frequency ray implanted in his tail, Skorpion, now known as the Neohedron, was able to turn people's head into crystals for the souls of the dead to control their body. He was released in Paris to begin the expansion of Life-Minus. When A.I.M.'s New Avengers attended the situation, they were able to revert the effects of Life-Minus in the innocent people and shatter Neohedron's crystal with Songbird's scream, seemingly sending Skorpion's soul back to the dead. Skorpion returned during Nyx's universe-spanning night. He allied with the Technocracy and tried to end humanity only to be casually defeated by Monica Rambeau.

evalla.name: Evalla
evalla.origin: In the times of elder Hyperborea, giant reptiles known as the Dragon Kings ruled Earth, including Lemuria. That time was known as the Age of Dragons. Among those giant reptiles rose kings and necromancers, the Dragon Kings, who had a wicked and cruel way of life. They built monolithic cities of black stone, and studied the dark arts. Witnessing the Dragon Kings' evil, the Nineteen Gods created the first men: Phondath the Firstborn and his mate Evalla.

evan mcbride.name: Evan McBride
evan mcbride.origin: ===School Shooting & Fear of Mutants=== Evan's early history is unknown, but he was a regular student to Costa Verde High School. He and his friend, Teddy, were the school's social outcasts. They would spend their days stirring public disturbances to gain attention. One day, Evan decided to make an example out of school's jock, Nick, by scaring him and the class with a pistol at lunch. Evan wanted to go out on a rampage and gain infamy. When Vice Principal Diller tried to get the gun out of his hand, Evan shot and killed him, causing him to gain national media attention. Teddy decided to stop him, but Evan shot him too. To Evan's surprise, Teddy was impervious to bullets; he was a mutant. To his own displeasure, while watching the news on a phone, reporters identified him and Teddy as mutants, something Teddy never wanted be associated with. To his second surprise, Teddy's sister, Liz revealed she was Firestar. While Firestar defended they have done nothing wrong, Evan decided to shoot Liz; she retaliated and blew out the cafeteria. Evan's fate is uncertain, but he was in front of Liz when she blew out the wall, suggesting he was killed.

evan sabahnur.name: Evan Sabahnur
evan sabahnur.species: Clone of the Immortal Mutant Apocalypse
evan sabahnur.origin: thumb|left|150px|Ultimaton guarding an incubating Genesis ===Origin=== When Fantomex killed the young Apocalypse, he, unbeknownst to his team, gathered some blood from the corpse while he closed the boy's eyes. Using the World, a scientific facility shrunken down to the size of a palm, he created a new child, who was guarded by Ultimaton. This was almost discovered when the Father attempted to take the World with his army of Deathloks, but Deadpool killed the father, inadvertently keeping Fantomex' secret safe. ===Dark Angel Saga=== thumb|right|200px|Genesis unleashed With Apocalypse dead, Warren Worthington, who had become the Horseman of Death Archangel, ascended to replace him. As a last-ditch effort to defeat Archangel and save the world, Fantomex unleashed En Sabah Nur. In the life simulation the World provided, he had been raised as Evan, a good person and a hero. Calling himself Genesis, he tried his best to defeat Archangel, providing the opportunity for Psylocke to attack him with a Life Seed. ===Jean Grey School=== After the battle, Fantomex decided to send Evan to Jean Grey School for Higher Learning. At his first day when he was introduced everyone noticed that he looked like Apocalypse, except Broo, who had never heard, seen or met Apocalypse and welcomed him. thumb|left|Evan's first day of school|250px When Deathlok came as a guest to Kitty Pryde's lecture and told some of the students part of their future. He foresaw a dark future for Evan, in which he killed Krakoa and became Apocalypse. Deathlok told him to find out who he was for himself. He also told Logan that Evan's potential for greatness was immeasurable and he would be either their most magnificent savior or trod upon their graves and that his fate rested entirely in Logan's hands. In a biology lecture which was taken inside Toad's body, Evan came across DNA believing that everything that made man was in there, only to be corrected by Beast that a person was more than the sum of his Genes. After the lecture, Evan seemed to be troubled and was asked by Idie if he was all right to which he answered that he was troubled by the biology lesson and many things and he felt that his life was much simpler before he came to the Jean Grey school. When the alarm was activated by Beast he moved with the other students to the safe rooms. Evan joined Warren in going to Planet Sin to take the device that could heal their headmaster's legs. He also forged a friendship with Warren. ===Avengers vs. X-Men=== While everyone was distracted by Cyclops visiting the school, Evan stayed inside reading about Apocalypse. When Husk saw what he was doing, he told her that he knew that that the other kids call him Kid Apocalypse and he could see that there was a resemblance, but vehemently stated that he would never become like Apocalypse. Later, Evan saved Warren from falling to his death, and when he learned that Warren could see the essence of others. he asked him to tell him what he saw when he looked at him. Warren told him that he could see only goodness inside him, but the truth was that Warren could only see the image of Apocalypse when he looked at him. ===Final Execution=== While on a field trip, Evan was captured by the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants whose leader Daken planned to turn him into the Brotherhood's own Apocalypse. The Shadow King used his powers to make an illusion for Evan and, disguised as Fantomex, started to tell him about Apocalypse and when he was killed by the X-Force. Evan woke up and found himself with The Brotherhood who was taking him to Kansas while Farouk was using his telepathy to hold his powers. When they stopped for fuel, The Brotherhood gave Evan the choice to kill Sabretooth before he killed everyone at the station, but Evan tries to stop him with a nonfatal attack and still warn the people there. This results in Sabretooth killing one woman that was escaping and the other people are shown dead on the ground outside the gas station, presumably killed by Shadow King and Daken. Their next stop was going to be Evan's house, but Evan escaped and tried to warn his parents only to find them dead at the hand of Daken and Sabretooth. In a moment of rage Evan almost killed them both but stopped so he would not become a murderer. At the same moment, Daken and Sabretooth told him that they did not and could not kill his parents as they were not real to begin with and that those who they "killed" were merely illusions created by the Shadow King. thumb After the Brotherhood told Evan the truth about his parents and that he was a clone of a boy, his "uncle Cluster" killed, and even came to think since Wolverine and his team hurt him with their lies someone should hurt them back. The Brotherhood unearthed one of Apocalypse's Celestial armors and offered him to take it and have his revenge. At first, Evan didn't do it, but he was seen approaching the armor as Deadpool came into the room pointing a gun toward him saying he couldn't do it bef

evandre.name: Evandrè
evandre.origin: Evandrè was one of the Amazons living in Themiscyra, on the Thermodon River, in Anatolia. Along with eleven other fellow Amazons Polemusa, Derinoè, Bremusa, Antandrè, Clonié, Hippothoè, Harmothoè, Alcibiè, Derimacheia, Antibrotè and Thermodosa, Evandrè accompanied Penthesilea who went to Troy in the last years of the Trojan War in order to cleanse her soul after the accidental murder of her sister and queen Hippolyta. The Amazons were acclaimed by the crowd and welcomed by King Priam and his family. There, Penthesilea swore that she and her Amazons would kill Achilles and repel the Argives back to their coasts, despite the accusation of arrogance from Andromache, widow of Hector whom Achilles had slain. The next day, they went to battle as the vanguard of the Trojans who were galvanized by Penthesilea. Priam prayed for help to Zeus, but saw an eagle grasping a dove and interpreted it as the fact Penthesileia would not return alive. Thersites alarmed the Argives, and they met the Trojans in the battlefield. There, Evandrè was killed by Meriones, along with Thermodosa. Witnessing the death of her Amazons, Penthesilea entered a fury, and was herself eventually killed by Achilles. Evandrè and the other Amazons were buried beside Penthesilea.

evangeline whedon.name: Evangeline Whedon
evangeline whedon.origin: thumb|left|Human form Vange Whedon is a lawyer and a member of the Mutant Rights Coalition (or Mutant Rights League). Her ability to shapeshift is triggered when she comes in contact with blood. Evangeline used to be a successful prosecutor until others soon learned that she was a mutant. She was fired instantly and evicted from her apartment the next day. Her fiancé left her with an e-mail and her family disowned her. When the X-Men Bishop and Sage were being held in police custody, Whedon and the Mutant Rights League staged a protest for their release. While Evangeline was talking to Detective Cardones, a human struck the detective with a brick. The blood from the wound dripped on to Whedon, and caused her to shapeshift involuntarily. She transformed into a beast that resembled a dragon, and was out of control. Sage was able to stop Vange momentarily, while Bishop calmed her down enough to revert to her human form. Evangeline was called to Los Angeles when the X-Men needed legal help. Evangeline succeeded in getting Marie D'Ancanto, an anti-mutant terrorist given a second chance by the X-Men, under probation and hired her as an assistant. Evangeline also helped the X-Men against a lawyer secretly working for the psychic mutant Elias Bogan. ===After M-Day=== She kept her powers after the Decimation of the mutant population, the government considers her a 'Significant' national security threat. ... Evangeline joined later the mutants on Utopia and was among them when the Nimrods were invading the island. She was later put on the case of Primal (Teon Macik), when his parents wanted him back, but wasn't really motivated into helping the X-Men.

eve.species: First woman of the Biblical mythos
eve.first_appearance: Bible Tales for Young Folk Vol 1 1
eve.origin: ===Origin and early years=== That story was recounted in Genesis 1,2,3.; Eve was originally known as The First Woman of Biblical Legend and created by the Creator alongside her mate, Adam, in the Garden of Eden. She at one point lived in peace, but one day was convinced by the Serpent to eat the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. She then gave a fruit to Adam to eat. Feeling ashamed of what they had done, and covering themselves, they were found by God who condemned mankind to pain and sorrow. He dressed them of coats of skin, expelled them from Eden, and placed a flaming sword to guard the Tree of Life.

eve android.name: Eve (Android)
eve android.origin: Eve is a Synthezoid created by the High Evolutionary in Counter-Earth, modeled after the Vision. After the members of the Avengers Unity Division were scattered across Counter-Earth when searching for Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch, the Vision found himself in a technologically highly-advanced dormant city, where he was lured to encounter Eve, who had been waiting for him for a long time. Vision fell in love with Eve, who, according to himself, completed him. In a short time after their first encounter, they started creating offspring to inhabit the empty city Eve was living in. Fearing the survival of their offspring could be under risk by the Evolutionary's mad plans, Eve planned to leave the Counter-Earth on a spaceship. Vision tried to convince her to raise their children on Earth, but she refused. On the last second, Vision left Eve and decided to help the Unity Division in their final fight against the High Evolutionary. Eve later contacted Vision, who had now returned to Earth, and showed him images of the world she had found for the children.

eve bakian.name: Eve Bakian
eve bakian.origin: Eve Bakian was a pregnant member of the Nova Corps whose expeditionary force was sent to find potential sites for new outposts. They detected a gravity anomaly in Xitaung, where they discovered a giant-size Power Stone. After one of her corpsmen turned out to be a Fraternity of Raptors spy and was killed, Bakian and the remaining members of her squad decided to drop off the radar, fearing the Nova Corps was compromised. thumb|left|Without helmet Bakian and her crew embezzled funds and stole resources to build a fortress in order to protect the Power Stone, so their actions didn't simply go unnoticed. Nova commander Scott Adsit sought the help of the Guardians of the Galaxy to investigate Bakian's squad, as part of his attempt to root out any spies and corrupt officers. Star-Lord and Rich Rider travelled to Xitaung and attacked the base, until Star-Lord noticed Eve was pregnant. He called a cease-fire, which led the situation to be clarified, and Eve to show them the Power Stone. Rider agreed that Eve couldn't disclose the discovery of the Power Stone to the Nova Corps as long as they were compromised, and helped Eve and her crew lay under the radar. When he and Star-Lord reported back, they claimed to have found Eve and her crew's graves in Xitaung, and pinned the embezzlement on a group of non-existent pirates that supposedly had stolen their identities before being killed by Star-Lord and Rider. Star-Lord later provided Eve with reinforcements, in the form of Drax, who agreed to live on Xitaung after deciding to leave the Guardians of the Galaxy. Before she could return home to give birth to her daughter, Eve saw herself forced to fend off concurrent invasions from the Fraternity of Raptors and the Chitauri. She went into labor in the middle of battle, and Gamora delivered the baby. She then fled the planet with the Guardians of the Galaxy and her fellow Nova Corpsmen when Xitaung crumbled apart when the Power Stone no longer no longer held it together. Later, the Nova Corps was wiped out by an alternate-reality Universal Church of Truth. Whether Eve was one of the Nova Corpsmen that perished or not is unknown.

eve greenwood.name: Eve Greenwood
eve greenwood.origin: During her childhood, Eve Greenwood lived with her twin sister Dawn and their father Reg in Anchor Bay, Massachusetts. Unlike Dawn, Eve spent her early adulthood travelling around the world. Eve still kept in touch with her family, and also acted as the travel agent for the Greenwood Inn. When Dawn became the companion of the Silver Surfer, Eve had to fill in for her sister in helping out their father at their inn. She fell in love and married one of the guests in the inn, the Brazilian Costas Prado, with whom Eve had a baby named Regina. Following Reg's death shortly after Regina's birth, Eve decided to sell the inn.

In an effort to save the infants, Bishop grabbed them and was whisked away.

evelyn cream.name: Evelyn Cream
evelyn cream.origin: Evelyn Cream, an agent of the Spookshow, was dispatched to investigate and cover-up the re-emergence of Miracleman. Interrogating terrorist Steven Cambridge, Cream promised not to kill him, and did so anyway. Deducing from Steven's information that Miracleman was secretly Michael Moran, he contrived a situation wherein Moran would be unable to get away or safely transform, in order to shoot him in the gut with tranquilizers. While Evelyn was ordered to kill Moran, he instead kidnapped him, reported a fake name to his superiors, and offered his services to Miracleman, believing that he could befriend and influence the superhuman. Cream guided Miracleman to the bunker where Project Zarathustra was conducted, betraying his superiors in favor of their creation. When the two learned the truth of Project Zarathustra and its director, he managed to calm Miracleman from a berserk rage and convinced him to leave. He later approached Sir Dennis Archer and convinced him to prevent the Spookshow from taking further action against either of them. Moran later enlisted Cream's help finding his wife, who had been kidnapped by Gargunza. Confirming that Kid Miracleman had not re-emerged, he next contacted Dennis Archer. Desperate to avoid Miracleman's wrath, Archer suggested his former employee search for the only other person who knows Miracleman's identity: Emil Gargunza. Tracking Gargunza to South America, Evelyn followed Miracleman to Gargunza's compound, where he briefly reunited Michael and Liz, before he and the temporarily-powerless Moran were chased into the jungle by Gargunza's Miracledog. He gave Moran his gun and split up with him to hopefully attract the creature away from Miracleman's lesser half. In his final moments, he realized the folly of trying to curry the favor of superhumans, as Miracledog chased him down and bit his head off. Years later, after Miracleman had taken over the world and established his pantheon, the Qys death god Mors resurrected Cream, as he had many others in his Underworld. Miracleman put his old ally in charge of a fake City where the inherently-treacherous intelligence community were confined for their own safety under para-reality programming. When one such agent attempted to escape the City, Cream approached her at the border to explain the purpose of the City. Disillusioned with her life as a spy and thus capable of being rehabilitated, Cream promised not to kill her, and allowed her to leave.

evelyn ives.name: Evelyn Ives
evelyn ives.origin: It seemed that Evelyn Ives was a beautiful girl created by the illusionist and the famous hypnotist Bart Cobb as a means of a prank to be played on the new kind and submissive neighbor Willard Peebles. Cobb arranged for Peebles to meet Evelyn and hoped that he would fall in love with her, and in fact he did, to the point that Peeble decided to marry her. At the wedding, Peebles' neighbors acted as witnesses, while Cobb was intent on continuing the prank by making Evelyn disappear while they were leaving for their honeymoon, but suddenly they saw a rocket take off with Peebles and his wife Evelyn on top and Cobb who could not make her disappear discovering, from what was written on the rocket, that Peebles was an alien from Mercury and was considered the greatest wizard in the universe, and Evelyn had become real.

evelyn mace.name: Evelyn Mace
evelyn mace.origin: Evelyn Mace was the wife of Fred Mace, she died under unrevealed circumstances. To get over his loss, Fred became engineer on the Mole a giant machine that was designed to bore down to the Earth's core, and served alongside Jan Court and Art Townes. The trio discovered an underground kingdom, which had a city of people and it's own sun and moon. Thye discovered the people down here were sorcerors who gave each of the three the appearance of their hearts desires, so Evelyn appeared to be alive. Fred and the others decided to permenantly live in the city.

evelyn necker.name: Evelyn Necker
evelyn necker.origin: Doctor Evelyn Necker was a spy of A.I.M. who she believed would bring a better world through science. She infiltrated Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. as the head of robotics, planning to use its data on the alien Warguard for her Minion Project. As part of P.E.G.A.S.U.S. she collected some radiation from the Negative Zone and contained it inside a quantum flask. ===Secret Invasion=== During the Secret Invasion, the Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. Facility was attacked by the Skrulls. The initial assault was repelled by the security chief, Darkhawk. When Nova arrived to help his brother, Robbie, he met his boss, Dr. Necker. Dr. Necker was able to download the Xandarian Worldmind from Nova to an experimental gestalt mainframe she created for the Minion Project. She used the Worldmind to open the quantum flask which revealed to be containing the incorporeal Quasar. The Worldmind soon appeared to both Necker and Robbie, and to defend the facility from the incoming attacks activated the Minion Project. ===New Nova Corps=== After the attack, Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. served as a base of operations for the new Nova Corps. During that time, Richard Rider and Dr. Necker began a relationship. While Necker was removing the Skrull booby traps left following the invasion, she accidentally set one off which released a blast. The blast deactivated the containment grid keeping the U-Foes imprisoned. Several U-Foes managed to escape, forcing Necker to alert Darkhawk of this. He managed to take down the prisoners, but his amulet began malfunctioning. Necker attempted to help him, only to be struck down by the amulet, leading to Darkhawk leaving out of fear of causing more harm. When the Xandarian Worldmind took Richard's powers, Necker, the Project's Director Gruenwald and Quasar expressed their concern over the Worldmind forcefully mass recruiting people for the Nova Corps. Rich asked them to perform tests on him to see if there were lasting consequences to his body housing the Nova Force for a long time. The director also tasked Necker with capturing a Nova Centurion in order to see if they were being manipulated. With Rich's help, Necker managed to lure inside an isolation chamber the Centurions Robbie and Irani Rael, finding out that the Worldmind was in fact controlling the newly recruited Corpsmen. Soon the the rest of the Nova Corps broke in to collect their fellow Corpsmen, allowing the Worldmind to regain control of them. Rich also learned from Necker that due to losing the Nova Force, his body was rapidly decaying and in the next 48 hours he would surely die. Necker and Gruenwald attempted to find a way to save Rich. Unfortunately, H.A.M.M.E.R. closed down Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. and fired her, though before she and Rich were kicked out she secretly got hold of the flask. She drove Richard to an unused A.I.M. base, where she attempted to drag up any resources to heal his decaying body. However, Richard noticed a beekeeper uniform and refused to be any lab rat. Eve assured him that she genuinely wanted to save his life and presented to him the quantum flask that Quasar was originally contained in, which could heal him. Instead, Rider passed up the chance and destroyed the flask. Appearing out of nowhere, Wendell Vaughn arrived with the Quantum Bands transforming Richard into the new Quasar and saving his life. With the dissolution of H.A.M.M.E.R., Necker and her fellow colleagues returned to P.E.G.A.S.U.S. However, an alternate reality version of Quasar from the Cancerverse infiltrated the facility and had all of the staff, including Necker, possessed by mind-controlling parasites. He wished to use the facility's equipment to construct the Horrorscope, a device that could open a portal to his reality. Both he and Necker lured Rich, now back as Nova, to the facility where they attempted to kill him. Rich evaded Quasar and the Guardsmen's attacks, and got hold of Necker, taking her to a gravity bubble where he separated the parasite from her and incinerated it. Coming to her senses, Necker explained to Rich the situation they were in, telling of the Horrorscope and its purpose. Rich made his way to the device, and with the help of Darkhawk destroyed it along with the monster controlling the parasites. However, Quasar got what he wanted and left, forcing Rich to go back to space to fight the forces of the Cancerverse, leaving Necker to tend to Darkhawk's wounds. ===Revolutionary War=== Necker came to be employed by Psycho-Wraith Prime who tasked her with creating an army of cyborgs for him and his master, and in exchange she could work on her Minion Project. Necker began working in a base at the Darkmoor Energy Research Centre, where she received additional funding from A.I.M. Mixing the technology she got from the Warguard with that of A.I.M. Necker was able to create a new line of powerful cyborgs. Following his capture by the Psycho-Wraiths, Death's Head II was given to Necker for studying, but only for a couple of hours. Using nano-prob

evelyn richards.name: Evelyn Richards
evelyn richards.origin: Evelyn Richards was the wife of scientist Nathaniel Richards and the mother of the couple's only child, their son Reed. She and her family lived at the Richards Family Estate in Central City, California. Nothing has been revealed about Evelyn's life prior to her marriage to Nathaniel, and very little has been revealed about her life after her marriage. However, it is known that she sometimes assisted her husband in his laboratory at their Central City home. When her eccentric brother-in-law Ted Richards had to appear before the on suspicion of being a communist, what he told the committee caused them to hold him on contempt of Congress for six months. Evelyn used to say that she was surprised that the stenography machines hadn't burst into flames. On one occasion, their young son Reed, who had just read the story of Humpty Dumpty in a Mother Goose storybook, entered the laboratory to ask his father a question. Nathaniel initially said he was too busy but, after Evelyn firmly said his name, he immediately changed his mind and asked what he could do for his son. When Reed asked if he knew why they couldn't put Humpty Dumpty back together again, both his parents were quiet for a moment, then Nathaniel told his son that that was a very good question and Evelyn agreed that it was another one and told her son that he was such a smart boy. Nathaniel and Evelyn then began telling Reed about temporal ordering, time's orientation and how it moves, like an arrow, from the past to the present. As Evelyn spoke of how some sequences of events could not happen in reverse order, like how cream could be stirred into coffee to turn it milky brown but it couldn't be unstirred, Nathaniel mentioned that physics said that, theoretically, it was possible due to something called. At this point, Reed interrupted his father, saying, "time reversal symmetry," then went on to describe that as the theory that if events can unfold in one direction, they should be able to unfold in the exact opposite sequence. Shocked that her son knew of such an advanced theory, Evelyn asked him how he knew that and how could he know that, but Reed was now lost in his thoughts and left the laboratory without answering, leaving both his surprised parents behind. At some point after he retired, Reed's grandfather, John Richards, came to live with Reed and his parents in California. This may (or may not) mean that the four Richardses all lived together under the same roof. Sometime later, when Reed was seven years of age, his mother died. The circumstances of her death have never been revealed. Decades later, Reed told his wife Sue that he could no longer remember his mother's eyes. He explained that, although his mother had died when he was only seven years of age, he had always had a very clear memory-image of her in his mind and he still had that image but now the eyes were gone, as if they had been erased. This realization had led Reed to discover that there were substantial gaps in his memory, things that might be important to him but were not always on his mind. A few years later, at the reading of Reed's will following his apparent death, Nathaniel was given a scrapbook of photographs of Reed as a child so that maybe he would realize what he had missed by not being around much back then. One of the photos was of a young Reed being held in his mother's arms. Later, during the Civil War, Reed told Peter Parker (Spider-Man) about his Uncle Ted and what his mother had said about Ted's testimony.

As Evelyn spoke of how some sequences of events could not happen in reverse order, like how cream could be stirred into coffee to turn it milky brown but it couldn't be unstirred, Nathaniel mentioned that physics said that, theoretically, it was possible due to something called. At this point, Reed interrupted his father, saying, "time reversal symmetry," then went on to describe that as the theory that if events can unfold in one direction, they should be able to unfold in the exact opposite sequence. Shocked that her son knew of such an advanced theory, Evelyn asked him how he knew that and how could he know that, but Reed was now lost in his thoughts and left the laboratory without answering, leaving both his surprised parents behind. At some point after he retired, Reed's grandfather, John Richards, came to live with Reed and his parents in California. This may (or may not) mean that the four Richardses all lived together under the same roof. Sometime later, when Reed was seven years of age, his mother died. The circumstances of her death have never been revealed. Decades later, Reed told his wife Sue that he could no longer remember his mother's eyes. He explained that, although his mother had died when he was only seven years of age, he had always had a very clear memory-image of her in his mind and he still had that image but now the eyes were gone, as if they had been erased. This realization had led Reed to discover that there were substantial gaps in his memory, things that might be important to him but were not always on his mind. A few years later, at the reading of Reed's will following his apparent death, Nathaniel was given a scrapbook of photographs of Reed as a child so that maybe he would realize what he had missed by not being around much back then. One of the photos was of a young Reed being held in his mother's arms. Later, during the Civil War, Reed told Peter Parker (Spider-Man) about his Uncle Ted and what his mother had said about Ted's testimony.

fields.notes: While Nathaniel Richards was fully introduced in his first storyline in , his wife was created a piece at a time, over the span of a decade. Reed's mother and the fact that she had died when Reed was only seven were first mentioned in , written by John Byrne, but he didn't give her a name. Her first name was revealed to have been Evelyn in , written by Dan Abnett. Her full name was revealed to have been Evelyn Richards in , written by Mike Lackey. That story contained the photograph that was the first image of her, drawn by Adriana Melo. Evelyn's first full appearance was in a flashback that Reed experienced in , written by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa and drawn by Jim Muniz. Over the past forty years, several writers have mangled Nathaniel's backstory by introducing new information about his life without making any real attempt to make it fit with what had previously been revealed. However, Evelyn's life story has not been developed much beyond the fact that she died when Reed was seven. The initial storyline in which Nathaniel Richards appeared gave the impression that he had raised Reed as a single parent after his wife's death. However, later stories revealed that, due to his choice to secretly become an agent for the mysterious organization known as the Brotherhood of the Shield, Nathaniel had had to leave his family when Reed was either a boy or a teenager, and he didn't see Reed again until his son was attending State University. So, after Nathaniel left his family, who raised Reed?

evelyn stanzler.name: Evelyn Stanzler
evelyn stanzler.origin: Evelyn Stanzler was a Justice Department agent who appointed Assistant District Attorney Matt Murdock to prosecute Clint Barton during his trial for the murder of Bruce Banner. Stanzler planned on manipulating Murdock and Judge Rappaport into making the jury reach Barton's conviction, with the intention to use the trial's outcome to promote the reinstitution of the Superhuman Registration Act, as she expressed it to the D.O.D.'s Walter Strakofsky. With the help of Barton's lawyer, Mr. Rikleen, Murdock found out about Stanzler's conspiracy and proceeded to ensure Barton had a fair trial, which resulted in his acquittal, to Stanzler's annoyance.

evenor.name: Evenor
evenor.origin: Evenor was one of the autochthons (primeval quasi-deities), the "offspring of the soil", and an Atlantean god known as Lord of the Water-Spirits. He was also the father of Cleito, mothered by Leucippe. When Neptune claimed Atlantis, he married Cleito, and they fathered the ten first kings of Atlantis, ten gods who ruled in the centuries between 18,500 and 18,000 BC. It was said that the land Atlantis prospered from the presence of the autochthons. As the guardian of the City of the Golden Gate, after Atlantis sank in the Great Cataclysm, Evenor was sworn to guard the Shroud of Cleito, an holy relic, in the City of the Golden Gate. He tried to prevent Namor from taking it and sullying it, and damning him in the name of the Ten. Namor finally accepted Evenor's wisdom.

ever.name: Ever
ever.origin: Ever was apparently one of the younger generation of Morlocks, exiled to The Hill dimension after Mikhail Rasputin saved them from the flooding of the Morlock Tunnels. When Callisto tracked the terrorist splinter group of Morlocks called Gene Nation back to Earth, she presented a hologram of the Nationals that included Ever in their ranks. For some reason, however, Ever was not among Gene Nation when they were captured by Callisto and the X-Men. Ever befriended Alex Summers when Havok decided to fight more aggressively for mutant rights as leader of the new Brotherhood of Mutants. They briefly hijacked a commercial airliner before getting removed by the X-Men. When Havok recruited his former brainwasher the Dark Beast in order to keep an eye on him, Ever retreated into the shadows. Instead of interacting with the untrustworthy McCoy and Fatale, he watched them from a distance on Havok's behalf. Once Ever learned McCoy was experimenting on innocent civilians, he reported the news to Havok.

everdrop of the green.name: Everdrop of the Green
everdrop of the green.origin: Highelf Everdrop was a Light Elf who, for nearly three hundred years, took care of Qaoyak, a tree that was a seedling from Yggdrasill. Every day he ensured that Qaoyak was shown love and affection since the tree radiated life, growth and joy for all who were near it, and Everdrop believed that one of the truths of the universe was that to grow love and joy in one's life, one must feed that love in the world. On the night before the anniversary of the end of the War of the Realms, Everdrop was ambushed on Qaoyak by Valg, a villain from another reality. After murdering Everdrop, Valg impersonated him during the following day's celebratory ceremony.

However, Rahn and his followers were massacred by Atlanteans who believed that they were invaders.

everett bliss.name: Everett Bliss
everett bliss.first_appearance: Captain America II: Death Too Soon
everett bliss.origin: Everett Bliss was an operative of the Government of the United States. He received orders from the President. When international terrorist General Miguel threatened to unleash an age-speeding chemical on several American cities, Bliss was sent to deal with the situation. Bliss contacted scientists Dr. Wendy Day and Dr. Simon Mills for expert advice; they confirmed Bliss that such a weapon was feasible. Bliss was reticent to deal with terrorists, as he had no way to know whether Miguel would (or could) honor his word; and at the same time, he thought that Miguel would not want to negotiate. The scientists worked overtime, but unsuccessfully, trying to develop an antidote. Bliss finally decided to not accept a blackmail, following the policy of the United States. Miguel sent a plane to spray the city of Portland, Oregon with his chemical, and then publicly announced that the antidote was available for one billion dollars. Mills stressed to Bliss the urgency of the situation, but Bliss still doubted that Miguel really had an antidote. Predicting Bliss' problem, Miguel offered a limited sample of the antidote. Dr. Day offered to travel to Portland and test it in one of the affected inhabitants. Bliss was thinking about tests in animals, but Day thought there was no time for that, and she left by plane (probably Bliss provided her the plane). Day risked her own life but confirmed that the antidote was operative; however, neither she nor Mills could produce more of it. Before Bliss could continue his telephone-based negotiations with Miguel, the terrorist was stopped by Captain America. Captain America also obtained enough antidote to heal the population of Portland.

everett clarke.name: Everett Clarke
everett clarke.origin: Everett Clarke used Wentworth Advertising, owned by Flint Wentworth, for his advertising campaign. Because of Wentworth's bad luck, following an antique lamp he had purchased and did not want to follow the advice of the seller who told him not to let the lamp go out or his bad luck would begin, Clarke broke the contract with Wentworth since his advertising campaign had gone terribly. After Wentworth convinced himself of the truth of the lamp's powers and continued to keep it lit, the bad luck passed and Clarke called him back telling him that he would continue to use Wentworth Advertising for his company's advertising campaigns.
