fandral.name: Fandral
fandral.origin: ===Early Life=== Fandral the Dashing was a charter member of the Warriors Three, a trio of Asgardian adventurers consisting of himself, Hogun the Grim, and Volstagg the Voluminous. Fandral was a strong and brave and a good friend to Thor. He fought in countless battles with his friends, to preserve and protect his people. He has been described as one of the most good-looking Asgardians which along with his charm, gave him the reputation as a ladies' man. Besides his looks, Fandral is also known for his skills in swordsmanship and bravery. He and Thor first met when the Warriors Three joined the Thunder God on an expedition to restore the Odinsword that had become cracked. Allegedly, Volstagg the Staggeringly Perfect led the youth Hogun the Good, Fandral the Quite Plain, Thor and Loki in Hel, fighting against all of its hordes for forty days and nights. Eventually Hogun was hurt and forced to retreat, helped by Fandral. Due to the battle, Hogun the Good became Hogun the Grim, and for some reason, Fandral the Quite Plain became Fandral the Dashing later, while Volstagg started eating every time and Thor was deemed worthy of Mjolnir. ===Robin Hood=== In the 13th Century; Fandral was being chased by a Storm Giant through a forest in Asgard when he fell through a portal. He landed on Midgard in England in an area known as Nottingham. He took down a group of soldiers who were harassing the locals for taxes. It was then that he met a woman named Marian. It was love at first site and she told him of the local governor who was stealing from the poor. He helped where he could robbing the rich to give to the poor. Over time he formed a band of Merry Men to help him. Working together he took down the governor and the false king as the true king returned to the throne. He married Marian and they settled in a home not far from Nottingham. However due to her mortal nature she aged and died while Fandral remained unchanged. After her death he returned to Asgard through a portal. It remained unclear if he truly was the inspiration for the legend of Robin Hood. ===Tales of Asgard=== Fandral and the Warriors Three accompanied Thor on a ship as they journeyed through the Sea of Fear and through the Pillars of Utgard, tossed by violent waters. Loki staged a mutiny with the aid of the dissenting Kroda and Magrat, splitting the crew in half and starting a fight between the two factions. Fandral and the Warriors Three sided with Thor and battled on as the ship headed toward the Dragon's Jaws. As their ship entered this lethal region, the battle was broken off by the sound of Balder, who had climbed to the top of the ship's masthead with a great horn, in hopes that its power might steer them to safety. Balder succeeded and the Jaw was blown to bits, allowing their ship to pass onto the next leg of their journey. Detecting the ship, Queen Ula of the Flying Trolls sent a squad to raid the ship. Balder the Brave had collapsed in exhaustion from using the giant horn. He was then nursed back to consciousness by Fandral and Hogun. Fandral led the Warriors Three in a counter attack to defend their ship from the looting Trolls. Loki unleashed a potion into the air that poisoned the Trolls. With the battle over, Loki took all the credit and gloated. Ula had anticipated this move and ordered her men to prepare a fitting welcome for the sons of Odin. Loki was captured by Ula, and Thor left to rescue him. Before Fandral and the Warriors Three were able to leave for a rescue attempt Thor and Loki appeared on the ship. Odin then appeared in a blinding flash and informed them that their quest was done and that they could return to Asgard. The Warriors Three returned home to learn news that Ragnarök loomed over Asgard. Odin showed them visions of their destruction. With the visions over, Odin asked all gathered what they thought about what they had seen as it was said Loki would be the cause of Ragnarok. Loki was tossed into the Well of Eternal Sleep, thereby preventing the coming of Ragnarok. Odin then called for his son and the Warriors Three. He requested they travel to Muspelheim and retrieve the Warlock Eye from the Temple of Mystics as it too was prophesied to be used to bring about Ragnarok. However the Warlock Eye had been taken by Harokin. He used the Eye's power to destroy the Fire Demons. As this battle raged on, Fandral and his friends began their journey. Fandral and the group fought Harokin's forces, and during the battle Thor sneaked into Harokin's chambers, knocked him out and took his place to retrieve the Eye. Posing as Harokin, Thor ordered Harokin's army to take the Warriors Three as live prisoners. With Harokin's army defeated, and the Warlock Eye in their possession, the friends traveled home. Fandral helped Hogun in defeating the conqueror Mogol of the Mystic Mountain who had slaughtered his people. Fandral once joined Thor on an odd mission to find a sorcerer named Ulagg. Using a twig of the World Tree Yggdrasill, they rest

fields.trivia: Fandral is not a genuine character from Scandinavian Myth. Fandral once claimed to have lived on Earth and married a woman named Marian. This seems to indicate that he was Robin Hood, though other sources claim that Robin Hood was a man imbued with a Pendragon spirit. As such, Fandral may have encountered the time-traveling Avengers. In the 'Three Musketeers' parallel of the Warriors Three, Fandral is unquestionably the 'Aramis' figure. Fandral as a character was inspired by Errol Flynn's performance as Robin Hood from the 1938 film, The Adventures of Robin Hood.

fang lilin.name: Fang (Lilin)
fang lilin.origin: ==Pre-Cataclysmic Age== Some time prior to the fall of Atlantis (approximately 18,000 BC) Lilith, the Mother of Demons, was imprisoned inside of the remains of the Leviathan, Tiamat. Her demonic offspring, the lilin, were scattered across the dimensions, and those who were left behind on Earth were either killed or fled into hiding, integrating themselves with humanity. ==Modern Age== Thousands of years later in the Modern Age, after Lilith was freed from her prison, she went seeking for the other lilin. At Lilith's command, Fang inserted some of himself into a serum intended to kill Morbius, instead mutating him.

fang snake.name: Fang (Snake)
fang snake.origin: According to jungle lore, Fang is a snake that goes out in the jungle to bite as many victims as possible once every 10 years. If true or not didn't make Fang any less dangerous. In 1954 the snake surfaced, biting various people and animals in the jungle the snakes venom driving them mad. Among the victims included jungle explorer Greg Knight friend of adventurer Lorna the Jungle Girl. fang wwii.name: Fang (WWII)
fang wwii.origin: The man known as Fang was a notorious member of Imperial Japan's spy network that was active in the United States during World War II. Stationed in San Francisco's Chinatown district, Fang would try to undermine American interests prior to their direct involvement in the war. In 1941, he would receive orders from Baron Nushima to prevent two Chinese emissaries from receiving a war loan from the US government to aid in their efforts to stop the Japanese from invading China. To this end, Fang would send his minions to kidnap Chang and Liang during their stay at Camp Lehigh before they were to appear in Washington D.C. Fang would accompany his hatchet men, knocking out Private Steve Rogers who was assigned to watch over the emissaries. Fang would have Liang cut down, and Chang captured, as well as Camp Lehigh's mascot James Buchanan Barnes. He would later also capture government agent Betsy Ross. He would torture Chang, and then before he could execute James, Steve (as Captain America) would rescue them all. Easily beating Fang and his minions into submission. With Fang and his minions defeated, Captain America and Bucky would leave them with Betsy Dean to turn over to the FBI. In the modern era, the Super-Adaptoid took on Fang's form to confuse Captain America, who had then just recently been revived after decades in suspended animation and was having trouble adjusting to all the time he had lost. According to Captain America, Fang was apparently killed during the bombing of Hiroshima in 1945. If this is true, Fang was likely one of the many souls that contributed to the Everwraith, a being comprised of the souls of those who were killed during the bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

fangella.name: Fangella
fangella.origin: The villainess known as Fangella started dating another villain, Dour Dead-head. As Dead-head had some friendly rivalry with Vizzion, he was invited to Vizzion's housewarming party in Leonia, and he took Fangella with him as his date. They were received by Vizzion's wife the Scarlett Wench. Dead-head was rude because Visionary had co-opted the brain partners of Dead-head's late brother Seymour; Fangella warmly shook the Wench's hand, explained Dead-head's behavior and congratulated the Wench for the house by saying it was hateful. They were attacked by party-pooping pillagers, who were cheered by Fangella because she hated that; but the Wench and the Visionary defeated them.

fangor.name: Fangor
fangor.origin: The wolf-man Fangor and his feline "brother" Felix were the servants of the genetecist Dr Scarabeus, who created them by splicing animal DNA into cloned humans. Fangor was Scarabeus's chief enforcer, but had a cowardly streak; he and Felix captured the Hulk for their master, but when the man brute released all of Scarabeus's earlier, failed experiments and Scarabeus ordered them to fire on their grotesque "brothers", Fangor and Felix fled.

fangor statue.name: Fangor (Statue)
fangor statue.origin: Fangor was a statue created by Fival Fuvnik, where it was displayed in Central Park. It was later brought to life by Rasputin using the Tavistick. However, the Tavistick was destroyed during a fight between Fangor and Iron Man, leaving Rasputin unable to control it. While Rasputin fled, Iron Man continued to fight Fangor, finally using the Unstable Freon Bomb to encase it in ice, allowing him to shatter it.

fantasia.name: Fantasia
fantasia.origin: Fantasia was a Dire Wraith, presumably arriving on Earth at some time during the Wraith War against Rom, the Spaceknight. She suffered amnesia and forgot her true form and mission. Under unrevealed circumstances, she came to use the magical powers she still possessed as an agent of the Soviet people. thumb|left|Human form As part of the , Fantasia used her abilities to disguise the team as the Avengers. While doing so they attacked the Soviet Super-Soldiers. Captain America was drawn into the conflict, and ended up saving Fantasia from a beast. As Fantasma, she was part of the People's Protectorate when the Supreme Soviets were renamed after the fall of the USSR. The Protectorate battled the Combine and the Peace Corpse. She also fought the Hulk and the Pantheon while trying to recover a renegade KGB agent from America. Fantasma was later seen as part of the Winter Guard as they battled the Mandarin and his Dragon of Heaven. After Darkstar died while serving with the X-Men, Fantasma was among those seven members of the Winter Guard who left to form a splinter group, the Protectorate, who sought a way to bring Darkstar back to life. They ended up in Limbo, where they made a deal to serve Immortus for a year in exchange for his help. However, before their year of service ended, Fantasma recovered her full memories, revealed herself to be a Dire Wraith, and traveled back to Earth, appearing in Saint Petersburg. Rescued by the current Winter Guard and brought to their base, the Citadel, a former Dire Wraith base that had been taken over by the Russian government, Fantasma pretended to not to remember her origins and let the Winter Guard leave the base. Once the team had gone, Fantasma made her way to a sub-basement where she found a hidden nursery full of Wraith eggs waiting to be born. Even as the Protectorate returned to Earth too and told the Winter Guard of what had happened in Limbo and that Fantasma was a Dire Wraith, Fantasma formed an alliance with The Presence and took over the former Winter Guard headquarters, and then, working together, they began to awaken the Wraith. The Winter Guard stormed the base and were attacked by the full force of Fantasia's Dire Wraith army. However, Powersurge and Red Guardian managed to make a device capable of defeating the Dire Wraiths and Crimson Dynamo boosted its signal, which created a tear in time that led to Limbo. This tear started to grow and would consume everything. In order to seal it, Galina threw Fantasia into the tear. Refusing to be destroyed by herself in vain, she dragged Starlight into the tear too. This caused the tear to collapse on itself and kill both of them.

far sight.name: Far Sight
far sight.origin: Far Sight was a member of the X-Ceptionals a group of superhero wannabes based in Seattle. Far Sight claimed to "know things" and have the ability to look into the future, though in truth, his predictions were generally vague enough that he could claim to have been correct after the fact. At some point, Far Sight was contacted by Mr. Tryp, who began giving him real visions of the future. Far Sight begged him to make the visions stop, but Tryp refused. Far Sight was then found dead, with a suicide note beside his corpse. Layla later told Madrox that Far Sight had been murdered, and could not have written the suicide note, as he was illiterate.

fara.name: Fara
fara.origin: Fara felt ignored by her Prince, the Sub-Mariner, and saw Lady Dorma as the only obstacle between her and Namor's heart. When she noticed Dorma taking a surface-dweller into her bedchamber, Fara seized the opportunity to turn Namor against her. She sped to Namor's side, and suggested that Dorma was secretly plotting with the surface-dweller. Namor rushed to Dorma's chambers to confirm this report, only to find that the mysterious surface-dweller had transformed into the Hulk. Battle ensued between the two titans, and Dorma was quickly knocked unconscious. Fara saw another chance to rid herself of Dorma, and snuck up to kill her while Namor was busy fighting. Unfortunately for Fara, the battle was still raging nearby, and a wall was toppled onto her. The wall instantly killed her, but Fara's body acted as a shield, saving Dorma.

farallah.name: Farallah
farallah.origin: ===Origin=== Farallah was one of the mystic Principalities, entities invoked for power. Very little is known of Farallah's origin, though, like virtually all of the Principalities, Farallah was presumably of extradimensional origin. Farallah was a member of the Octessence, eight Principalities that all claimed to be the most powerful among them. Its dimension, Farallah, was a brutal realm within the Archipelago of Anguish and Redemption, set beyond Krakkan and adjacent to the realm of Brutus Klor and the Murder Clans, servants of Farallah. Thousands of years ago, eight great mystics met to see who was the most powerful. To avoid an open conflict, it was decided they would enter into the Wager of Octessence, where each would create a Totem that contained some of their powers, and whoever touched it would become an avatar, or "Exemplar". Farallah placed his power inside Fearsome Fist of Farallah which he placed in the Andean temple of Farallah, in Peru. ===Modern Age=== ====War of the Seven Spheres==== Like all members of the Octessence, Farallah participated in the War of the Seven Spheres, although it was not seen petitioning Doctor Strange to fight for it in exchange for the power borrowed, like many other powers and principalities did. ====Wager of the Octessence==== Thousands of years later, the temple in Peru was discovered by Nigel Pigman but Andreas Zorba became the Exemplar, Carnivore, as the Wager of the Octessence was launched.

farbauti.name: Farbauti
farbauti.origin: ===Origin=== Farbauti was the wife of Laufey, king of the Frost Giants in Jotunheim. She gave birth to unusually small child named Loki much to the annoyance of her husband. Ashamed of his son's small size, Laufey kept Loki hidden from his people. It was said that the night Loki was born, she stabbed her own heart with an ice dagger, but Loki suspected Laufey could had been the real perpetrator of her death. When Odin led the Asgardians into battle against the Frost Giants and killed their king Laufey in personal combat. Afterwards, Odin found Loki hidden within the Frost Giants' primary stronghold. ===Mother=== Mother was an interdimensional parasite that lurked in the Multiverse seeking out powerful beings and realities to feed on. She tethered herself to parents and began to act overbearingly parental and protective; she impersonated Farbauti to trick Loki.

farbird.name: Farbird
farbird.origin: Farbird was a soldier of Tian equipped with an armored flight suit. Operating high above the newly established mutant territory in Utah, he observed the activities of Kitty Pryde and the other surviving mutants. Farbird reported what he saw to his superior, Karen Grant, who instructed him to remain in position and continue monitoring the settlement. Grant was particularly interested in learning what Kitty Pryde was doing with the newly established mutant community.

farcus.name: Farcus
farcus.origin: Farcus was a centuries-old monster who inhabited Monster Metropolis, and the last of his kind. Due to his old age, he was in a fragile mental state. One day he wandered off and found himself at the Manhattan subway. The bystanders were terrified by his presence and the state of rage in which he was due to his inability to find his way back home. A mob opened fire on him and ultimately killed him. As soon as her guards noticed Farcus had gone missing, Queen Shiklah travelled to the subway to retrieve him, but was too late. Farcus' death was the tipping point that promped Shiklah to invade the surface.

fargo kid.name: Fargo Kid
fargo kid.origin: The Fargo Kid was an outlaw who lived during the days of the American Frontier. A wanted murderer, he was on the run from the law and eventually ended up in the mountains near the town of Red Dog, Texas. There he sought refuge in a shack owned by an elderly and poor prospector named Luke. The Kid was unaware that a local named Kansas had murdered Luke, seeking fortune, and finding none. In order to avoid implication and prosecution by the local sheriff, Blaze Carson, Kansas had attempted to pin the murder on the Fargo Kid. When the Kid burst into the cabin as Blaze and Kansas were observing the crime scene. Blaze easily out drew Fargo and gunned him down. Blaze soon deduced that Kansas murdered Luke and brought him to justice.

fargo north.name: Fargo North
fargo north.origin: While on the case of some bank robbers, Upton North sought out his brother of Fargo North for his help. Fargo initially refused, believing his brother his superior, but was convinced by Spider-Man and the Electric Company to join his and caught up with Upton. Spider-Man secretly followed them and the trio discovered the robbers but Upton and Fargo fell into a pit while the robbers escaped. Spidey pulled the brothers out of the pit. Fargo devised a plan to catch the robbers using a Newspaper headline to convince the crooks Fargo had won some money. The three robbers arrived to steal the money were caught in a trap of Spider-Man's webbing. Upton then declared that Fargo was just a good as he was and that he'd given him friends, which he had never had enough of himself.

farley london.name: Farley London
farley london.origin: Farley was a magician, gambler, and master of disguise that was hired by Spymaster to join his Espionage Elite. Farley and the Espionage Elite aided Spymaster in stealing secrets from Stark Industries, resulting in them coming into conflict with Iron Man, Mike O'Brien, and some security guards. The Espionage Elite were eventually defeat and abandoned by Spymaster. Farley and the team were later reunited by Spymaster in order to hack Iron Man's armor. However, the hacker Spymaster hired, Glitch, chose to turn on the team, allowing the Espionage Elite to be captured. Spymaster escaped but was later captured. When the Espionage Elite, no longer working for Spymaster, planned a heist at Avengers Mansion, Godfried Herter betrayed the team, planning to take all the money for himself. He reprogrammed the Avengers Training System to target and kill anyone carrying his uniquely built phone, managing to kill both Farley and Roger Phillips before Wasp stopped him.

farley warner.name: Farley Warner
farley warner.origin: With the end of a range war, Farley Warner had lost track of his family and believes them to be dead. Enraged by this, he vows to get revenge against those he holds responsible. He refuses to listen to reason, rushing out of the sheriffs office with guns blazing and is spotted by the Western Kid. When the sheriff tries to return fire, the Kid tries to maintain the peace by having Lightning try to take the guns out of Farley's hands. With Warner disarmed, the sheriff agrees to release him into the Kid's custody but warns Tex that he will be responsible for anything that Farley does. The Western Kid puts up Farley in his hotel room, but in the middle of the night Warner wakes up and tries to leave. When Lightning tries to stop him, Farley kicks the dog in the face and climbs out the window. Awoken by the confrontation, the Western Kid is unable to stop Farley from getting away. He sends Lightning after Farley, and follows the dog's trail. Not far ahead at the home of homesteader Buck Hawser, Farley breaks in and confronts Buck, accusing him of starting the range war that took Warner's family away. farnsworth hill.name: Farnsworth Hill
farnsworth hill.origin: Dr. Farnsworth Hill, a professor at New York University and author of a book titled The Super-Soldier, interviewed to talk about the birth of the Avengers, said regarding the birth of Captain America that Dr. Erskine was paranoid enough and smart enough not to have written down the super soldier formula. After his death, many had tried to replicate it but with disastrous results and with the creation of various monstrosities. Furthermore, Hill said that Captain America, as a symbol of a nation, was created in contrast to the figure of the Nazi Red Skull.

faro james.name: Faro James
faro james.origin: Hearing that Faro James was plotting to rob the Gold Cost Express which was carrying a large sum of gold, the Rawhide Kid races to the train on his horse Apache and jumps aboard. The Kid doesn't know what Faro looks like so he begins provoking other passengers to see if they will reveal themselves as James, but none of them do. When the conductor notices that the train is going faster than scheduled, the Rawhide Kid realizes that Faro is in the engine and races to the front of the train. There he subdues Faro and learns that his gang is waiting further down the line to help rob the train. The Kid uses the train's headlight to blind the outlaws and shoots the guns out of their hands and takes them into custody, foiling Faro's plot.

farouk al fasaud.name: Farouk Al-Fasaud
farouk al fasaud.origin: Once the powerful oil minister of Aqiria and — according to CBS journalist Gregory Dunbar - the richest man on Earth — Farouk Al-Fasaud was ruined after Dunbar began an investigation into his life which uncovered unsavory information and prompted other journalists to follow suit, rapidly threatening to bring Fasaud down. Blaming Dunbar for the scrutiny, Fasaud attempted to stab the journalist with a knife at a television studio but instead struck a camera. Somehow, the resulting electrical shock completely converted Fasaud into an electronic image. Dunbar escaped the incident unharmed. Pursuing Dunbar to New York City, Fasaud fought the Fantastic Four. Fasaud nearly killed the Human Torch with his powers, but was thwarted by cable insulation wielded by the Thing. The Thing and Ms. Marvel traveled to Aqiria to investigate the government to determine their ties to Fasaud. Meanwhile, Fasaud made another attempt to kill Dunbar, but was stopped by an electrical storm triggered by Crystal. Retreating to Aqiria, Fasaud incapacitated the Thing and Ms. Marvel with an electrical discharge, then chained them to a launch shuttle. In orbit, Fasaud intended to hijack a satellite in order to transmit himself all over the world. Grimm destroyed the satellite, however, trapping Fasaud aboard the shuttle, then proceeded to destroy all the electronic equipment in the shuttle itself. The Thing and Ms. Marvel escaped, but Fasaud was left for dead. Somehow, Fasaud survived, and recently aided R.A.I.D. in their terrorist attacks on London, using his ability to take over electronic devices to let known super-criminals into the country with their weapons without arousing suspicion. He was caught, however, by an MI5 telepath who felt Fasaud's mind within the machinery. Threatened with execution via a localized electromagnetic pulse, Fasaud chose to aid the British government in containing the terrorists, but was thrown at R.A.I.D. agent Ecstasy to defuse her connection to the Darkforce dimension and thus neutralize her powers after she had attacked MI5 headquarters in an attempt to release her cohorts. Apparently swallowed by the Darkforce, Fasaud's current whereabouts are unrevealed.

farys.name: Farys
farys.origin: A skilled breeder of tiding-flies, Farys was a former lover of Par%l prior to their bondmaker D%nel's untimely death at the hands of the Breaker-Apart. Losing all hope at the sight of the Breaker-Apart's near-complete destruction of the cosmos as well as its maiming of hir ship, the Observer's Berth, Farys chose to fly in the face of the rules of tiding-fly breeding and create a specimen capable of travelling 10 billion years into the past in order to serve as a warning to the people of the previous cosmos. This tiding-fly was entrusted to Par%l and, as hir ship left the Berth in search of guidance from O%los, the lights on the Berth slowly went out, signifying Farys' own death as well as the dire finality of the cosmos' situation.

fascination.name: Fascination
fascination.origin: ===Technet=== Fascination is one of a group of alien mercenaries who operate across the multiverse and throughout time. She originated as a -born Gallifreyan. Under the name Scatterbrain, she encountered Captain Britain as part of the Technet. thumb|left The Technet encountered Captain Britain on several subsequent occasions, and have also clashed with Excalibur and the Fantastic Four. Later in her own timeline (but earlier from a linear perspective), Scatterbrain would become known as Fascination and work for Wardog's Special Executive. She was first seen as one of the Special Executive members sent to Earth-616 to abduct Captain Britain on the orders of Saturnyne, and the Special Executive subsequently fought The Fury alongside both Saturnyne and the Captain. ===Earth-92131=== Fascination was among the Technet team who briefly visited Earth-92131.

fascit.name: Fascit
fascit.origin: Fascit was one of the Deviants living in Lemuria during the rule Priestlord Ghaur. Working directly for the priesthood, Fascit obeyed Ghaur's personal commands. Ghaur captured human woman Margo Damian, who was Ghaur's enemy's Ikaris' girlfriend, to use her as a hostage. Ghaur ordered Fascit to turn Damian into a Deviant so that Ikaris would be unable to find her. At that point, the Deviant priest caste had developed advanced technology, decoding and logging a person's genetic matrix, along with recently-built machines that would modify a person's genetic matrix so as to trick any sensor. Working along Ghaur's co-conspirator Ahqlau, and with several technicians, Fascit fastened the prrisoner on a chair and performed the molecular and atomic manipulation, including several dermal penetrations, that changed Damian's appearance into an ape-like being, purportedly for at least one week. However, when Fascit prompted Damian to move, he noticed that the subject had not survived the process. Ahqlau was worried that Ghaur or Ikaris would kill them for their failure. They were unable to hide the situation from Ghaur, but the Priest-Lord decided against killing Fascit, and instead looked for another Deviant, Yrdisis, to impersonate Damian. When Ghaur took Yrdisis to Fascit's laboratory and contolled her mind, they discovered that Yrdisis had already been impersonated by Ikaris's ally Sersi, who was then under Ghaur's control. After Ghaur's defeat, the priest caste lost a lot of their power and prestige. It's unclear what happened to Fascit.

fat cobra.species: Peng Lai Human Ghost who defeated Xiang Yao and gained the power and mantle of Cobra Warrior from taking his chi
fat cobra.origin: ===Early Life=== The man known only as Fat Cobra (Chinese: 胖眼鏡蛇, Pàng Yǎnjìngshé) was born 111 years ago on Peng Lai Island, one of the legendary Seven Capital Cities of Heaven. His parents were pig farmers, and his mother died giving birth to him. As an infant, his appetite proved so great that his father could not afford to feed him, and he was left on the doorstep of an orphanage. As he grew, the orphanage found him to be a burden, and at the age of two years old, he was banished from Peng Lai. After his exile from Peng Lai, he was taken in by a Peking opera school and was trained in dance and acrobatics, as well as his first instruction in the martial arts. He went on to become one of the most promising young opera singers in all of China. He spent several years traveling with the Peking opera. His first kill took place in a coffeehouse located in Cairo in 1924, in what started out as a drunken argument, and ended with Fat Cobra punching the other man through a wall. left|thumb|Xiang Yao He then fled back to China and joined the army. He used different identities and fought for both sides in the Chinese Civil War, with both sides wanting to make him a general. He used the money he had earned to buy his way back into Peng Lai and began learning at a Kung Fu school ran by Iron-Crutch Khan. His ultimate goal was to defeat Xiang Yao, the great snake who lived in the caves under Peng Lai. Doing so, he would earn the title of Cobra Warrior and join the ranks of the Seven Immortal Weapons. His dream, along with his large size led to Khan giving him the name Fat Cobra out of mockery. Two days after his first attempt to defeat Xiang Yao, he washed up on the shores of the Chinese mainland, beaten to a pulp, partially eaten, and barely alive. He was found by a deformed old woman who lived along the shore. She nursed him back to health but took advantage of him sexually all the time he was comatose. After recovering, he discovered that he had been exiled from Peng Lai a second time. left|thumb right|thumb In 1933, he began serving as a sidekick for Ulysses Bloodstone, embarking on a series of adventures that took him to the far corners of the globe. He also traveled to both the Savage Land and Monster Isle and fought the Moloids and Fin Fang Foom. In 1939, he was the sole survivor of a team of Kung Fu commandos put together by British hero Union Jack to take down Hitler's secret death squad of S.S. ninjas led by the notorious butcher Herr Samurai. left|thumb He was then invited to join the Axis-fighting squad the Kid Commandos along sidekick heroes Bucky and Toro, but he instead chose to sit out the rest of the war, preferring to teach self-defense classes at an all-girls college in Switzerland. thumb He then spent a little time in Hollywood, California appearing in bit roles for films, and played defensive end for the New York Giants for two seasons until the league kicked him out for seriously wounding several protesters from the Ku Klux Klan. left|thumb He eventually worked for an underground fighting circuit that ranged from Wakanda to Atlantis, and for years remained undefeated in death matches. right|thumb At one point, he even found himself in Olympus in an eating contest against gods Hercules and Volstagg. left|thumb He helped teach Kung Fu to Elvis Presley, and at the height of the Cold War, he found himself in government service again, this time taking down Russians with S.H.I.E.L.D. and Nick Fury. right|thumb After several years honing his skills, he tried unsuccessfully once again to defeat Xiang Yao, and wound up legless and paralyzed, and spent the following two years at a S.H.I.E.L.D. medical facility. Fat Cobra has also had countless romantic companions over the years, fathering an unknown number of children, but estimated in the hundreds. These children ultimately began to hunt Fat Cobra down with the intent to kill him. For years, they came after him from all over the world, and Fat Cobra killed them all, making him into the warrior that he is today, and giving him his ultimate victory over Xiang Yao and the Cobra Warrior title. ===Biography=== left|thumb By the modern day, he had forgotten most of this tragic history until reminded by his biographer Carmichael, who had learned his story after extensive research, a set of revelations Fat Cobra found most sobering. ===Immortal Weapons=== At the Heart of Heaven, the Immortal Weapons are the champions of the Seven Capital Cities of Heaven. Each would face each other in various arenas. A preliminary fight was drawn which opened the tournament. Fat Cobra entertained the gathered by defeating the 100 Shaolin Terror Priests in the exhibition match. Because he won, he was allowed to selected his opponent for the first match of the tournament and he chose to fight The Immortal Iron Fist. The Steel Phoenix revealed his identity. Dog Brother was tasked with introducing Fat Cobra and Prince of Orphans. The Prince of Orphans decided instead to challenge Steel

fatale.name: Fatale
fatale.species: Depowered mutant modified by Dark Beast; Repowered by Terrigenesis; Depowered back by Terrance Hoffman
fatale.origin: thumb|left|160px|Fatale ===Origin=== Little is known about the childhood and youth of Fatale' and how she came to be Dark Beast's most trusted servant. It is possible that Dark Beast created her himself. ===Servant of Dark Beast=== When Dark Beast became interested in the X-Man Bishop, he placed Fatale undercover as a waitress in Harry's Hideaway, a bar the X-Men often visited. Fatale somehow scanned Bishop's mind to find his ideal woman and changed her appearance to match this image. She took the name Pamela Greenwood, but she failed to get any closer to Bishop. Bishop noticed something familiar about Pamela, but never pursued his interest in her. Several months later, as Havok was losing control of his powers, Dark Beast ordered Fatale to kidnap Havok so that he could brainwash him. Fatale was also working against Scarlett McKenzie, a woman Havok had known and loved, but who had allegedly died years before. Intrigued by Scarlett's reappearance, Havok left his team X-Factor to investigate, but was captured by Fatale. X-Factor and their ally Yukio defeated Fatale and freed Havok. A second attempt was made by Dark Beast, using Random, succeeded, and Fatale brought Havok to Dark Beast. ===Dark Descendants=== After his visit to the Age of Apocalypse, Bishop began having nightmares. He felt that Pamela Greenwood was somehow connected and went to her apartment to question her. Pamela revealed herself as Fatale and fought Bishop, but Dark Beast, monitoring the fight, called her off when Beast entered the fight. Seeing a new opportunity to infiltrate the X-Men, Dark Beast kidnapped Beast and took his place. When Onslaught attacked the X-Men, Dark Beast revealed himself and offered his services to Onslaught. Dark Beast, Random, Fatale and a brainwashed Havok formed the Dark Descendants and fought X-Factor, but were defeated. Havok and Random escaped, but Dark Beast and Fatale were sent to prison. Fatale was later present among the many mercenaries trying to kill the ninja assassin Elektra. ===Havok's Brotherhood=== Havok became aware that Dark Beast's experiments might still be ongoing. Allying himself with the telepath/teleporter Ever, he transformed the Dark Descendants into a new Brotherhood of Mutants by freeing Fatale and Dark Beast from prison, telling them that he chose Fatale over Ever and that he wanted both of them to join his terrorist team. Both agreed, but Havok disbanded the group several weeks later when he discovered Dark Beast's hidden lab. Fatale sided with Dark Beast, but was defeated by Havok. ===M-Day=== Fatale was depowered during M-Day. Coming to believe that the United States government was responsible for M-Day, she joined other former mutants in the terrorist X-Cell, using blades and guns along her fighting skills in replacement of her powers. After Blob attempted to steal food from Multiple Man and Rictor, resulting in a fight between Rictor and Blob, she was forced to step in and attack Multiple Man, cutting one of his dupes with a poison-tipped blade. thumb|right|140px|Resenting the Terrigen Mist|Mists side effect thumb|left|Repowered Fleeing with Blob in a stolen car, the two were stopped by a manhole cover left open by Strong Guy and Wolfsbane, and Fatale was thrown from the car. The two groups fight again before retreating. thumb|right|350px|Nils Styger (Earth-616)|Abyss taking Fatale and Reaper with him to the [[Brimstone Dimension]] She was later repowered by the Terrigen Mist, and participated to the brawl with X-Factor and a army of Madrox dupes. When the repowering effects were starting to wear off and their powers became unstable (Elijah Cross had exploded seconds before), she was sucked into the Brimstone Dimension, along with Reaper, by Abyss, who wanted to stop them exploding and hoped that the Brimstone dimension could stabilize or drain their powers. The status of their powers and their whereabouts afterward were unknown to Madrox and Valerie Cooper. ===Frozen and returned=== Abyss turned out to be right about the Brimstone dimension's capabilities - time had completely frozen around both Fatale and Reaper, preventing them from exploding. A.I.M. scientist Terrance Hoffman managed to drag them out using some machin and captured them, draining their energies from them and leaving them powerless. When Serval Industries X-Factor came to the A.I.M. base to free the mutants (not knowing their identities), Hoffman was about to vivisect her to drain their powers and power himself. Fatale eventually fled and made an attempt to find Abyss and Reaper. Polaris found and freed Fatale and, once the battle was over, she encouraged Reaper and repelled Lorna when her teammate was trying to achieve Hoffman while he was knocked out. As he was denied the opportunity by Quicksilver, this led to an attempt to fight with the speedster, not over Hoffman's life, but about Pietro's involvement in the former prisoners' current fate. Fatale promised to Polaris and X-Factor that she, Abyss and Reaper

weapons: Fatale's gauntlets have retractable poison-tipped blades, laser- and plasma-blasters, conventional guns.

father.name: Father
father.origin: The man known only as "Father" was a scientist on a secret robotics project funded by Weapon Plus UK known as Project Descendant based on the original Human Torch. The three scientists on the project were known to each other as Father, Mother, and Brother. When science failed Project Descendant, Father resorted to magic, using the Orb of Necromancy to animate their best twenty failures as perfectly functional synthezoid "High-Breeds", potentially the first of a new android species. Father wanted to unveil them, but the trio fell to arguing and the synthezoids were released into the wild. Father's actions after that are unknown. He eventually created an underground city of robotic intelligences, to which he has worked to lure the descendants of the High-Breeds. He continued to work for Weapon Plus, working out of their facility, The World; he retained access to the facility despite the destruction of the Weapon Plus Program, and the subsequent shrinking and theft of The World by Weapon XIII. Father was working on Weapon Infinity, the ultimate extension of the Deathlok Project: an entire timeline in which every superhuman had been converted into a Deathlok, linked together without ego to make the world a better place. However, when Weapon Infinity was threatened by something Fantomex was growing in The World, Father directed soldiers of the Deathlok Nation to return through time and destroy it to safeguard their timeline. He was confronted by Deadpool, who beheaded him. However, Father survived using the advanced technology he had access to, and retreated to the City of the Descendants. He came into conflict with the Secret Avengers after his forces interfered with one of their missions. Father plans to be a threat to the group, as they have the comatose remains of the android original Human Torch. Finally, the Descendants decided to rise and take the world, raiding important cities of the planet and launching a nano-mist, which slowly started turning every human into machines. The Secret Avengers fought the Descendants, and the Human Torch managed to destroy the Orb of Necromancy (retrieved from an alternate universe), which killed every single one of the descendants of the High-Breed and eliminated the nano-mist from any human. Before dying, the Father told Captain Britain he still felt the presence of another Descendant who didn't die. The Father somehow returned, and attempted with the Descendants to liberate a Stark Sentinel being held by A.I.M. on the A.I.M. Island. The Avengers arrived to confiscate the robot and faced the Descendants. After using a neural inhibitor, Giant-Man shut them down, the equivalent of killing them.

father adam.name: Father Adam
father adam.origin: Father Adam was an ex-Army Ranger who became a priest. When he began committing some unnamed sin, he prayed to Hell to help him cover it up, selling his soul in the process. When Kazann manifested on Earth, Hell called in their marker, making Adam kill his entire congregation by blowing up his church. He headed to Texas in order to kill the Ghost Rider. He tried to shot a bullet anointed with holy water at the Ghost Rider but failed at the first attempt, leading the Ghost Rider to burn him alive. Still alive, Adam managed to score his second shot before succumbing to his wounds and burns. In Hell, Father Adam was awakened by Hoss disguised as God, who made him believe for a few instants that his sins were forgiven.

father artemis.name: Father Artemis
father artemis.origin: St. Benedict's Cathedral in Manhattan has been blasphemously vandalized, and Father Lazar is shocked to find that his colleague Father Artemis has become possessed by a demon (and is the cause of the vandalism) when he suddenly breaks off his sermon and speaks blasphemous words in a woman's tongue and jumps off the pew and seriously injures himself. Taken to the room inside the Cathedral where Father Artemis is being kept, Gabriel confronts the demon possessing his body. He's shocked to find that it is Catherine, the demon who possessed him and forced him to tear out one of his own eyes. When Catherine fails at keeping possession of Artemis, the creature tries to possess Gabriel but finds itself violently cast out of his body, and disappears. With the exorcism complete, Gabriel moodily departs the scene.

father cathal.name: Father Cathal
father cathal.origin: Father Cathal was a priest at a Catholic Church located in Hell's Kitchen. He was there to help a young Matthew Murdock after his father left him there to confess his sins. Father Cathal provided guidance to Matt throughout the years after Matt lost his sight and when he became the masked hero, Daredevil.

father coen.name: Father Coen
father coen.origin: Father Coen was the head of St. Ezekiel's Cathedral. He phoned the Fantastic Five hotline and asked for their help with supernatural problems. He declined the suggestion of Doctor Strange, due to Strange's occult conections, so the Fantastic Five soon arrived to aid him. When they arrived, they found Father Coen possessed by Mephisto, and he easily captured them. When they were freed, Coen, now released from Mephisto's control, asked them what had happened to the Human Torch and the Silver Surfer, to which Mister Fantastic replied that Johnny was dead and that the Surfer wouldn't be coming back. The remaining Fantastic Five members then left the church, telling Coen that he would have no more supernatural problems.
